summary_brief: 2026年3月26日，AI Agent生态呈现三大新趋势：GitHub原生集成能力跨越（gptme实现issue/PR/合并命令，Cline引入Kanban看板，项目管理能力向平台级演进）；测试驱动开发（TDD）规模化落地（gptme单日200+测试用例，覆盖0→全面突破，testcontainers真实环境测试成为新标准）；多Provider路由抽象标准化（OpenAI any-llm适配器、gptme entry points插件架构，厂商锁定风险正在系统性消除）。MCP协议继续深化，从"工具调用协议"演进为"跨平台互操作层"（mem0 Streamable HTTP transport、deepagents MCP采样工具）。安全加固从沙箱隔离升级为系统性认证与速率限制。这些变化标志着AI编程工具正从"辅助编码"向"完整开发平台"跨越，是3/21以来模块化重构和安全工程化趋势的最新落地节点。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议生态扩张与互操作标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: MCP 协议正在成为 AI Agent 工具扩展的行业标准接口，多个项目（continue、opencode、claude-agent-sdk-python、deepagents、mem0）同时推进 MCP 支持增强和互操作性实现，mem0 新增 Streamable HTTP transport、deepagents 支持 MCP 采样工具，表明 MCP 正在从单点能力扩展向跨平台互操作层演进。

engineering_signals.title: 测试基础设施与 TDD 投入显著增加
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 单日提交 4 个测试相关 PR，共新增约 200+ 测试用例，覆盖 dirs.py、keyword_matching、file_storage、terminal utilities 等多个模块，实现覆盖率从 0 到全面的突破。同时 Claude Code SDK 迁移测试到 testcontainers，deepagents 重构 eval 分类体系，表明 AI Agent 项目正从快速迭代向工程化质量保障转型。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 平台深化 GitHub 原生集成
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 新增原生 GitHub issue 创建、评论、PR 合并命令，替代 shell 回退方案，显著提升 AI Agent 在 GitHub 工作流中的可靠性。同时 Cline 推出 Kanban 看板功能集成工作树、自动 commit、自动 PR 和任务链接，表明 AI Agent 正从代码生成工具向完整项目管理平台演进。

engineering_signals.title: 多 Provider 路由抽象成为行业趋势
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Agents SDK 新增 any-llm 适配器实现 responses 兼容路由的标准化 abstraction layer，gptme 通过 entry points 实现插件化 LLM Provider 架构（支持 MiniMax 等任意提供商），continue、LlamaIndex 同时新增 MiniMax M2.7 模型支持。多 Provider 统一抽象正在消除厂商锁定风险，降低 AI Agent 平台的模型切换成本。

engineering_signals.title: 跨平台兼容成为刚需，Windows 支持全面增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 新增 PowerShell 工具作为 Windows opt-in 预览，openai/codex、gptme、cline 等项目同时增强 Windows 路径处理和 shell 模式支持，修复 macOS python 命令不一致问题。跨平台兼容正从加分项变为刚需，反映 AI 编程工具向更广泛开发者群体渗透的趋势。

engineering_signals.title: 安全隔离与认证流程全面加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同时推进安全加固：openai/codex 和 google-gemini/gemini-cli 增强沙箱安全阻止路径遍历和恶意代码执行，openclaw 对 webhook 实现速率限制和认证节流，claude-agent-sdk-python 修复 CLAUDECODE 环境变量泄露问题。AI 编程工具的安全基础保障正在成为行业共识。

release_signals.title: Cline v3主版本升级
release_signals.why_it_matters: Cline从v2跃升至v3，引入Kanban看板功能作为CLI默认启动界面，并新增重复工具调用循环检测以防止无限循环浪费token，标志着该工具从简单代码助手向完整项目管理平台的演进。

release_signals.title: Zed编辑器1M上下文窗口支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Zed更新BYOK集成以支持Claude Opus和Sonnet的新1M上下文窗口，这是业界首次在IDE层面原生支持超长上下文窗口，将极大提升大型代码库的分析和重构能力。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK any-llm适配
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Agents Python SDK新增any-llm适配器支持，实现responses兼容路由的标准化 abstraction layer，使开发者能更灵活地在不同LLM提供商间切换，降低厂商锁定风险。

release_signals.title: Continue集成MiniMax新提供商
release_signals.why_it_matters: Continue新增MiniMax作为LLM提供商（默认M2.7模型），丰富了多模型编排的选择，同时修复了大量模型兼容性问题并优化了Ollama/Gemini等主流模型的支持。

release_signals.title: CrewAI企业级内存与存储
release_signals.why_it_matters: CrewAI 1.12系列新增Qdrant Edge存储后端、实现分层内存隔离的自动root_scope、以及OpenAI兼容的原生提供商支持，显著增强了多智能体协作的企业级能力。

release_signals.title: Claude Code新增PowerShell支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code新增PowerShell工具作为Windows opt-in预览，并引入工作树创建钩子支持、新的环境变量配置选项等企业级功能，扩展了在Windows生态的实用性。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw Teams SDK迁移与AI UX
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw迁移至官方Microsoft Teams SDK并引入AI-agent UX最佳实践（流式回复、欢迎卡片、反馈机制等），同时新增Gateway OpenAI兼容性和容器化CLI支持，显著扩展了多平台集成能力。

release_signals.title: Vercel Agent工具链自动化
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel CLI新增Agent工具链自动安装功能，在login/link/deploy时自动检测Claude Code/Cursor并提示安装Vercel插件，标志着AI编程工具与云平台深度集成的趋势。

release_signals.title: LlamaIndex MiniMax与Gemini3集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: LlamaIndex新增MiniMax LLM提供者集成（默认M2.7）并更新Gemini 3默认配置，持续扩展对新兴模型的支持并优化Azure OpenAI响应式API兼容性。

release_signals.title: Phoenix Agent Chat工具调用优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: Arize Phoenix将工具调用折叠为可展开池并优化流式性能，同时新增会话切换器和异步摘要功能，提升了AI观测平台的响应速度和用户体验。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added PowerShell tool for Windows as an opt-in preview. Learn more at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference#powershell-tool
- Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL_SUPPORTS` env vars to override effort/thinking capability detection for pinned default models for 3p (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry), and `_MODEL_NAME`/`_DESCRIPTION` to customize the `/model` picker label
- Added `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` env var to configure the streaming idle watchdog threshold (default 90s)
- Added `TaskCreated` hook that fires when a task is created via `TaskCreate`
- Added `WorktreeCreate` hook support for `type: "http"` — return the created worktree path via `hookSpecificOutput.worktreePath` in the response JSON
- Added `allowedChannelPlugins` managed setting for team/enterprise admins to define a channel plugin allowlist
- Added `x-client-request-id` header to API requests for debugging timeouts
- Added idle-return prompt that nudges users returning after 75+ minutes to `/clear`, reducing unnecessary token re-caching on stale sessions
- Deep links (`claude-cli://`) now open in your preferred terminal instead of whichever terminal happens to be first in the detection list
- Rules and skills `paths:` frontmatter now accepts a YAML list of globs
- MCP tool descriptions and server instructions are now capped at 2KB to prevent OpenAPI-generated servers from bloating context
- MCP servers configured both locally and via claude.ai connectors are now deduplicated — the local config wins
- Background bash tasks that appear stuck on an interactive prompt now surface a notification after ~45 seconds
- Token counts ≥1M now display as "1.5m" instead of "1512.6k"
- Global system-prompt caching now works when `ToolSearch` is enabled, including for users with MCP tools configured
- Fixed voice push-to-talk: holding the voice key no longer leaks characters into the text input, and transcripts now insert at the correct position
- Fixed up/down arrow keys being unresponsive when a footer item is focused
- Fixed `Ctrl+U` (kill-to-line-start) being a no-op at line boundaries in multiline input, so repeated `Ctrl+U` now clears across lines
- Fixed null-unbinding a default chord binding (e.g. `"ctrl+x ctrl+k": null`) still entering chord-wait mode instead of freeing the prefix key
- Fixed mouse events inserting literal "mouse" text into transcript search input
- Fixed workflow subagents failing with API 400 when the outer session uses `--json-schema` and the subagent also specifies a schema
- Fixed missing background color behind certain emoji in user message bubbles on some terminals
- Fixed the "allow Claude to edit its own settings for this session" permission option not sticking for users with `Edit(.claude)` allow rules
- Fixed a hang when generating attachment snippets for large edited files
- Fixed MCP tool/resource cache leak on server reconnect
- Fixed a startup performance issue where partial clone repositories (Scalar/GVFS) triggered mass blob downloads
- Fixed native terminal cursor not tracking the text input caret, so IME composition (CJK input) now renders inline and screen readers can follow the input position
- Fixed spurious "Not logged in" errors on macOS caused by transient keychain read failures
- Fixed cold-start race where core tools could be deferred without their bypass active, causing Edit/Write to fail with InputValidationError on typed parameters
- Improved detection for dangerous removals of Windows drive roots (`C:\`, `C:\Windows`, etc.)
- Improved interactive startup by ~30ms by running `setup()` in parallel with slash command and agent loading
- Improved startup for `claude "prompt"` with MCP servers — the REPL now renders immediately instead of blocking until all servers connect
- Improved Remote Control to show a specific reason when blocked instead of a generic "not yet enabled" message
- Improved p90 prompt cache rate
- Reduced scroll-to-top resets in long sessions by making the message window immune to compaction and grouping changes
- Reduced terminal flickering when animated tool progress scrolls above the viewport
- Changed issue/PR references to only become clickable links when written as `owner/repo#123` — bare `#123` is no longer auto-linked
- Slash commands unavailable for the current auth setup (`/voice`, `/mobile`, `/chrome`, `/upgrade`, etc.) are now hidden instead of shown
- [VSCode] Added rate limit warning banner with usage percentage and reset time
- Stats screenshot (Ctrl+S in /stats) now works in all builds and is 16× faster

key_changes: 新增 Windows PowerShell 工具（opt-in 预览版）
新增多个环境变量支持配置默认模型（ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL_SUPPORTS）和流超时（CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS）
新增 TaskCreated hook 和 WorktreeCreate hook 对 HTTP 类型的支持
Deep links 打开首选终端而非首个检测到的终端
MCP 服务器本地配置优先于远程配置，支持去重；工具描述限制在 2KB
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.84 版本带来了丰富的功能增强：新增 PowerShell 工具预览版和多个配置型环境变量，扩展了 hook 系统支持；同时优化了 Deep links 行为和 Token 计数显示格式，修复了语音按住说话和方向键的问题，改进了系统提示缓存在 MCP/ToolSearch 环境下的兼容性。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `taskBudget` option for API-side token budget awareness, allowing the model to pace tool use within a token limit
- Added `enableChannel()` method and `capabilities` field on `McpServerStatus` for SDK-driven MCP channel activation
- Exported `EffortLevel` type (`'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'max'`) for consumers to reference effort values directly
- Fixed showing "[Request interrupted by user]" for errors that were not caused by user interruption
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.84

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.84
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.84
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.84
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.84
```

key_changes: 新增 `taskBudget` 选项，支持 API 端 token 预算感知，允许模型在 token 限制内控制工具使用节奏
新增 `enableChannel()` 方法和 `capabilities` 字段，支持 SDK 驱动的 MCP 通道激活功能
导出 `EffortLevel` 类型（'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'max'）供开发者直接引用
修复了非用户中断导致的错误也显示 "[Request interrupted by user]" 的问题
与 Claude Code v2.1.84 保持版本同步更新
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.2.84 版本主要增强了 SDK 的 token 预算控制能力和 MCP 通道管理能力。新增的 `taskBudget` 选项允许模型在 token 限制内智能调度工具使用，而 `enableChannel()` 方法和 `capabilities` 字段则提供了更灵活的 MCP 通道激活机制。同时修复了错误提示的显示问题，并与 Claude Code 最新版本保持同步。

## What's New

### Security Hardening (v3.5.45)
- Prototype pollution prevention via `safeJsonParse()` — strips `__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`
- NaN/Infinity bypass protection in `validateNumber()`
- Task source allowlist (`VALID_TASK_SOURCES`) prevents injection
- Atomic file writes (tmp + rename) for state persistence
- Shared `autopilot-state.ts` module eliminates 140 lines of duplication

### Token Drain Prevention (v3.5.46) — #1427, #1330
- Daemon `autoStart` defaults to `false` (opt-in only)
- Session hook `startDaemon` defaults to `false`
- Background workers reduced 10 → 3, schedules relaxed (audit 4h, optimize 2h)

### P1 Bug Fixes (v3.5.47)
- **#1122**: HNSW ghost entries — bridge delete path now invalidates HNSW index
- **#1117**: Orphan processes — worker timeout raised 5min → 16min
- **#1111**: Headless stdin pipe hang — already fixed (closed)
- **#1109**: classifyHandoffIfNeeded — Claude Code platform issue (closed)

### RuVector WASM CLI Exposure (v3.5.48)
- **ADR-067**: RuVector WASM utilization audit and improvement plan
- 4 new CLI commands: `agent wasm-status`, `agent wasm-create`, `agent wasm-prompt`, `agent wasm-gallery`
- Fixed 16 pre-existing ruvllm-wasm test failures (mock constructors)

## Test Results
- 28/28 test files pass
- 1725/1725 tests pass, 0 failures

## Install
```bash
npx @claude-flow/cli@latest
npx claude-flow@latest
npx ruflo@latest
```

Token 消耗防护：守护进程 autoStart 默认关闭，后台 worker 从 10 减少至 3，调度的审核周期延长至 4 小时
Bug 修复：HNSW 幽灵条目导致删除路径失效、孤儿进程超时问题（5min → 16min）
新增 4 个 WASM 相关 CLI 命令：wasm-status、wasm-create、wasm-prompt、wasm-gallery
修复 16 个 ruvllm-wasm 测试失败问题

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `managed-settings.d/` drop-in directory alongside `managed-settings.json`, letting separate teams deploy independent policy fragments that merge alphabetically
- Added `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged` hook events for reactive environment management (e.g., direnv)
- Added `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` setting to exit with an error when sandbox is enabled but cannot start, instead of running unsandboxed
- Added `disableDeepLinkRegistration` setting to prevent `claude-cli://` protocol handler registration
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1` to strip Anthropic and cloud provider credentials from subprocess environments (Bash tool, hooks, MCP stdio servers)
- Added transcript search — press `/` in transcript mode (`Ctrl+O`) to search, `n`/`N` to step through matches
- Added `Ctrl+X Ctrl+E` as an alias for opening the external editor (readline-native binding; `Ctrl+G` still works)
- Pasted images now insert an `[Image #N]` chip at the cursor so you can reference them positionally in your prompt
- Agents can now declare `initialPrompt` in frontmatter to auto-submit a first turn
- `chat:killAgents` and `chat:fastMode` are now rebindable via `~/.claude/keybindings.json`
- Fixed mouse tracking escape sequences leaking to shell prompt after exit
- Fixed Claude Code hanging on exit on macOS
- Fixed screen flashing blank after being idle for a few seconds
- Fixed a hang when diffing very large files with few common lines — diffs now time out after 5 seconds and fall back gracefully
- Fixed a 1–8 second UI freeze on startup when voice input was enabled, caused by eagerly loading the native audio module
- Fixed a startup regression where Claude Code would wait ~3s for claude.ai MCP config fetch before proceeding
- Fixed `--mcp-config` CLI flag bypassing `allowedMcpServers`/`deniedMcpServers` managed policy enforcement
- Fixed claude.ai MCP connectors (Slack, Gmail, etc.) not being available in single-turn `--print` mode
- Fixed `caffeinate` process not properly terminating when Claude Code exits, preventing Mac from sleeping
- Fixed bash mode not activating when tab-accepting `!`-prefixed command suggestions
- Fixed stale slash command selection showing wrong highlighted command after navigating suggestions
- Fixed `/config` menu showing both the search cursor and list selection at the same time
- Fixed background subagents becoming invisible after context compaction, which could cause duplicate agents to be spawned
- Fixed background agent tasks staying stuck in "running" state when git or API calls hang during cleanup
- Fixed `--channels` showing "Channels are not currently available" on first launch after upgrade
- Fixed uninstalled plugin hooks continuing to fire until the next session
- Fixed queued commands flickering during streaming responses
- Fixed slash commands being sent to the model as text when submitted while a message is processing
- Fixed scrollback jumping when collapsed read/search groups finish after scrolling offscreen
- Fixed scrollback jumping to top when the model starts or stops thinking
- Fixed SDK session history loss on resume caused by hook progress/attachment messages forking the parentUuid chain
- Fixed copy-on-select not firing when you release the mouse outside the terminal window
- Fixed ghost characters appearing in height-constrained lists when items overflow
- Fixed `Ctrl+B` interfering with readline backward-char at an idle prompt — it now only fires when a foreground task can be backgrounded
- Fixed tool result files never being cleaned up, ignoring the `cleanupPeriodDays` setting
- Fixed space key being swallowed for up to 3 seconds after releasing voice hold-to-talk
- Fixed ALSA library errors corrupting the terminal UI when using voice mode on Linux without audio hardware (Docker, headless, WSL1)
- Fixed voice mode SoX detection on Termux/Android where spawning `which` is kernel-restricted
- Fixed Remote Control sessions showing as Idle in the web session list while actively running
- Fixed footer navigation selecting an invisible Remote Control pill in config-driven mode
- Fixed memory leak in remote sessions where tool use IDs accumulate indefinitely
- Improved Bedrock SDK cold-start latency by overlapping profile fetch with other boot work
- Improved `--resume` memory usage and startup latency on large sessions
- Improved plugin startup — commands, skills, and agents now load from disk cache without re-fetching
- Improved Remote Control session titles: AI-generated titles now appear within seconds of the first message
- Improved `WebFetch` to identify as `Claude-User` so site operators can recognize and allowlist Claude Code traffic via `robots.txt`
- Reduced `WebFetch` peak memory usage for large pages
- Reduced scrollback resets in long sessions from once per turn to once per ~50 messages
- Faster `claude -p` startup with unauthenticated HTTP/SSE MCP servers (~600ms saved)
- Bash ghost-text suggestions now include just-submitted commands immediately
- Increased non-streaming fallback token cap (21k → 64k) and timeout (120s → 300s local) so fallback requests are less likely to be truncated
- Interrupting a prompt before any response now automatically restores your input so you can edit and resubmit
- `/status` now works while Claude is responding, instead of being queued until the turn finishes
- Plugin MCP servers that duplicate an org-managed connector are now suppressed instead of running a second connection
- Linux: respect `XDG_DATA_HOME` when registering the `claude-cli://` protocol handler
- Changed "stop all background agents" keybinding from `Ctrl+F` to `Ctrl+X Ctrl+K` to stop shadowing readline forward-char
- Deprecated `TaskOutput` tool in favor of using `Read` on the background task's output file path
- [VSCode] Spinner now turns red with "Not responding" when the backend hasn't responded for 60 seconds
- [VSCode] Fixed session history not loading correctly when reopening a session via URL or after restart

key_changes: 新增 `managed-settings.d/` 目录，支持团队独立部署策略片段并按字母顺序合并
新增 `CwdChanged` 和 `FileChanged` 钩子事件，支持环境响应式管理（如 direnv）
新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1` 环境变量，自动剥离敏感凭证信息
新增转录搜索功能（`/` 键搜索，`n`/`N` 跳转匹配项）及外部编辑器快捷键 `Ctrl+X Ctrl+E`
修复启动冻结、大文件 diff 超时、macOS 退出挂起等 9 项关键问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.83 版本带来了丰富的功能增强，包括团队级别的策略管理目录、文件/目录变更钩子事件以及敏感凭证自动剥离等安全特性，同时修复了启动性能、diff 稳定性和 macOS 兼容性问题，整体提升了 Claude Code 的可用性和健壮性。

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `seed_read_state` control subtype to seed `readFileState` with `{path, mtime}` so `Edit` works after the originating `Read` was removed from context
- Changed `session_state_changed` events to opt-in: set `CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS=1` to receive them
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.83

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.83
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.83
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.83
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.2.83
```

key_changes: 新增 `seed_read_state` 控制子类型，支持用 `{path, mtime}` 初始化 readFileState
解决 Read 操作从上下文移除后 Edit 无法工作的问题
`session_state_changed` 事件改为 opt-in 模式，需设置环境变量启用
与 Claude Code v2.1.83 保持版本同步

## Changes

### PR [#2075](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2075) by [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan) and [mikaelpr](https://github.com/mikaelpr): refactor: extract OAuth and auth logic from Codex client module

- Refactored the Codex client module by extracting all OAuth and authentication logic into a dedicated module, improving separation of concerns.
- Removed the OAuth flow, PKCE handling, and token refresh logic from `codex.go`, streamlining the client's core responsibilities.
- Removed the auth transport round-trip retry logic, simplifying the HTTP transport layer.
- Removed JWT parsing and token expiry utilities, along with unused OAuth types and helper structs, reducing dead code in the package.
- Added a test for `SendStream` HTTP error mapping and channel close behavior, improving test coverage for the client module.

## v3.5.43 — Critical Issue Remediation & Stub Removal

### Summary

Resolves 9 GitHub issues, replaces 22 fake-success stubs with honest errors, and fixes all healthcare plugin test failures. See [ADR-067](v3/implementation/adrs/ADR-067-critical-issue-remediation-v3543.md) for full details.

### Issues Resolved

| Issue | Title | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| #1390 | `memory_store` crash on ONNX worker threads | `process.exit(0)` after init to avoid ONNX hang |
| #1391 | MCP tool prefix inconsistency | Standardized `claude-flow` prefix in hive-mind prompts |
| #1392 | Worker tracking incomplete | PID singleton + SIGKILL fallback in daemon |
| #1393 | Headless worker stdin pipe error | Pipe stdin, bypass nested session detection |
| #1394 | Swarm commands stub-only | Real MCP calls + `.swarm/state.json` persistence |
| #1395 | Model alias resolution fails | Map short names → dated model IDs |
| #1396 | Global `-f` flag collision | Removed from parser; subcommands use `--format` |
| #1397 | `ruvllm-tools` JSON Schema invalid | Added `items` to 4 array schemas |
| #1398 | Vector dimension mismatch (1536 vs 384) | Updated `config-adapter.ts` default |

### Fake-Success Stubs Replaced (22 total)

All stubs now return `{ success: false, exitCode: 1 }` with guidance:

- **config.ts** (5): `init`, `set`, `reset`, `export`, `import`
- **deployment.ts** (6): `deploy`, `rollback`, `status`, `environments`, `release`, `logs`
- **migrate.ts** (4): `status`, `run`, `verify`, `rollback`
- **claims.ts** (5): `list`, `grant`, `revoke`, `roles`, `policies`
- **providers.ts** (2): `configure`, `test`

### Healthcare Plugin Fixes

- Fixed `MCPToolResult` type to match MCP SDK format (`{isError, content}`)
- Fixed RBAC role case-sensitivity (lowercase → uppercase normalization)
- Fixed `OntologyNavigationInputSchema` missing default for `direction`
- Injected bridge mocks in tests (bypasses ESM vi.mock issues)
- **Result: 23 test failures → 0**

### Test Results

- **1709 tests passing** (net +6 from v3.5.42)
- **23 healthcare failures fixed**
- Pre-existing failures unchanged (controller-registry: 1, ruvllm-wasm suite isolation: 16)

### npm Packages

All three packages published with `latest`, `alpha`, and `v3alpha` dist-tags:

```
npm i @claude-flow/cli@3.5.43
npm i claude-flow@3.5.43
npm i ruflo@3.5.43
```

### PR

- #1435 (`fix/critical-issues-adr-060`)

医疗保健插件全面修复：MCPToolResult类型、RBAC角色大小写、schema默认值问题全部解决
测试从23个失败降至0个，医疗保健插件测试100%通过
标准化MCP tool前缀、修复model alias解析、修复vector dimension不匹配

This week's release includes BYOK support for the new 1M context window on Claude Opus and Sonnet, git panel improvements including a badge showing uncommitted change counts and file type icons, an action to align multiple cursors, pinch-to-zoom in the image viewer, and an easier way to unbind default key bindings.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Updated BYOK integration to support the new 1M context window for Claude Opus and Sonnet. ([#51625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51625))

- Fixed highlight tree view usability. ([#51927](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51927))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

Replaced the `edit_prediction_conflict` key context with `edit_prediction && (showing_completions || in_leading_whitespace)`.
The `edit_prediction` context is now available whenever a prediction is present, rather than being mutually exclusive with `edit_prediction_conflict`.
This change will be migrated automatically, however, will be a breaking change if you previously depended on `edit_prediction` and `edit_prediction_conflict` being mutually exclusive.

Additionally, the default behavior now uses `edit_prediction && showing_completions` (without `in_leading_whitespace`), meaning tab will accept a completion rather than inserting a literal tab when the cursor is in leading whitespace and a prediction is present.

If you previously customized your edit prediction keybindings, you can likely simplify your `keymap.json` significantly using `"unbind"` - see the [docs](https://zed.dev/docs/ai/edit-prediction#edit-predictions-keybinding).

releases.summary:
### Breaking

### Changes

- Gateway/OpenAI compatibility: add `/v1/models` and `/v1/embeddings`, and forward explicit model overrides through `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/responses` for broader client and RAG compatibility. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Agents/tools: make `/tools` show the tools the current agent can actually use right now, add a compact default view with an optional detailed mode, and add a live "Available Right Now" section in the Control UI so it is easier to see what will work before you ask.
- Microsoft Teams: migrate to the official Teams SDK and add AI-agent UX best practices including streaming 1:1 replies, welcome cards with prompt starters, feedback/reflection, informative status updates, typing indicators, and native AI labeling. (#51808)
- Microsoft Teams: add message edit and delete support for sent messages, including in-thread fallbacks when no explicit target is provided. (#49925)
- Skills/install metadata: add one-click install recipes to bundled skills (coding-agent, gh-issues, openai-whisper-api, session-logs, tmux, trello, weather) so the CLI and Control UI can offer dependency installation when requirements are missing. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- Control UI/skills: add status-filter tabs (All / Ready / Needs Setup / Disabled) with counts, replace inline skill cards with a click-to-detail dialog showing requirements, toggle switch, install action, API key entry, source metadata, and homepage link. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- Slack/interactive replies: restore rich reply parity for direct deliveries, auto-render simple trailing `Options:` lines as buttons/selects, improve Slack interactive setup defaults, and isolate reply controls from plugin interactive handlers. (#53389) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- CLI/containers: add `--container` and `OPENCLAW_CONTAINER` to run `openclaw` commands inside a running Docker or Podman OpenClaw container. (#52651) Thanks @sallyom.
- Discord/auto threads: add optional `autoThreadName: "generated"` naming so new auto-created threads can be renamed asynchronously with concise LLM-generated titles while keeping the existing message-based naming as the default. (#43366) Thanks @davidguttman.
- Plugins/hooks: add `before_dispatch` with canonical inbound metadata and route handled replies through the normal final-delivery path, preserving TTS and routed delivery semantics. (#50444) Thanks @gfzhx.
- Control UI/agents: convert agent workspace file rows to expandable `<details>` with lazy-loaded inline markdown preview, and add comprehensive `.sidebar-markdown` styles for headings, lists, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, and details/summary elements. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- Control UI/markdown preview: restyle the agent workspace file preview dialog with a frosted backdrop, sized panel, and styled header, and integrate `@create-markdown/preview` v2 system theme for rich markdown rendering (headings, tables, code blocks, callouts, blockquotes) that auto-adapts to the app's light/dark design tokens. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- macOS app/config: replace horizontal pill-based subsection navigation with a collapsible tree sidebar using disclosure chevrons and indented subsection rows. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- CLI/skills: soften missing-requirements label from "missing" to "needs setup" and surface API key setup guidance (where to get a key, CLI save command, storage path) in `openclaw skills info` output. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- macOS app/skills: add "Get your key" homepage link and storage-path hint to the API key editor dialog, and show the config path in save confirmation messages. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- Control UI/agents: add a "Not set" placeholder to the default agent model selector dropdown. (#53411) Thanks @BunsDev.
- Runtime/install: lower the supported Node 22 floor to `22.14+` while continuing to recommend Node 24, so npm installs and self-updates do not strand Node 22.14 users on older releases.
- CLI/update: preflight the target npm package `engines.node` before `openclaw update` runs a global package install, so outdated Node runtimes fail with a clear upgrade message instead of attempting an unsupported latest release.

### Fixes

- Outbound media/local files: align outbound media access with the configured fs policy so host-local files and inbound-media paths keep sending when `workspaceOnly` is off, while strict workspace-only agents remain sandboxed.
- Security/sandbox media dispatch: close the `mediaUrl`/`fileUrl` alias bypass so outbound tool and message actions cannot escape media-root restrictions. (#54034)
- Gateway/restart sentinel: wake the interrupted agent session via heartbeat after restart instead of only sending a best-effort restart note, retry outbound delivery once on transient failure, and preserve explicit thread/topic routing through the wake path so replies land in the correct Telegram topic or Slack thread. (#53940) Thanks @VACInc.
- Docker/setup: avoid the pre-start `openclaw-cli` shared-network namespace loop by routing setup-time onboard/config writes through `openclaw-gateway`, so fresh Docker installs stop failing before the gateway comes up. (#53385) Thanks @amsminn.
- Gateway/channels: keep channel startup sequential while isolating per-channel boot failures, so one broken channel no longer blocks later channels from starting. (#54215) Thanks @JonathanJing.
- Embedded runs/secrets: stop unresolved `SecretRef` config from crashing embedded agent runs by falling back to the resolved runtime snapshot when needed. Fixes #45838.
- WhatsApp/groups: track recent gateway-sent message IDs and suppress only matching group echoes, preserving owner `/status`, `/new`, and `/activation` commands from linked-account `fromMe` traffic. (#53624) Thanks @w-sss.
- WhatsApp/reply-to-bot detection: restore implicit group reply detection by unwrapping `botInvokeMessage` payloads and reading `selfLid` from `creds.json`, so reply-based mentions reach the bot again in linked-account group chats.
- Telegram/forum topics: recover `#General` topic `1` routing when Telegram omits forum metadata, including native commands, interactive callbacks, inbound message context, and fallback error replies. (#53699) thanks @huntharo
- Discord/gateway supervision: centralize gateway error handling behind a lifetime-owned supervisor so early, active, and late-teardown Carbon gateway errors stay classified consistently and stop surfacing as process-killing teardown crashes.
- Discord/timeouts: send a visible timeout reply when the inbound Discord worker times out before a final reply starts, including created auto-thread targets and queued-run ordering. (#53823) Thanks @Kimbo7870.
- ACP/direct chats: always deliver a terminal ACP result when final TTS does not yield audio, even if block text already streamed earlier, and skip redundant empty-text final synthesis. (#53692) Thanks @w-sss.
- Telegram/outbound errors: preserve actionable 403 membership/block/kick details and treat `bot not a member` as a permanent delivery failure so Telegram sends stop retrying doomed chats. (#53635) Thanks @w-sss.
- Telegram/photos: preflight Telegram photo dimension and aspect-ratio rules, and fall back to document sends when image metadata is invalid or unavailable so photo uploads stop failing with `PHOTO_INVALID_DIMENSIONS`. (#52545) Thanks @hnshah.

### Patch Changes

-   eb64ca4: ### Bug Fixes

    -   **Re-apply download behavior on recording context** - Fixed an issue where downloads were silently dropped in recording contexts because `Browser.setDownloadBehavior` set at launch only applied to the default context. The download behavior is now re-applied when a new recording context is created (#1019)
    -   **Reap zombie Chrome process and fast-detect crash for auto-restart** - Added a non-blocking process-exit check before attempting CDP connection checks. This prevents a 3-second CDP timeout when Chrome has already crashed or exited, enabling faster detection and auto-restart of the browser (#1023)
    -   **Route keyboard `type` through text input** - Fixed keyboard `type` subaction to correctly route through the text input handler, and added support for an `insertText` subaction using `Input.insertText` (#1014)

issue_insights.summary_brief: 跨仓库分析发现 5 类高优先级共性问题：P0 级「静默失败」（53 个仓库受影响，无错误反馈导致任务中途停滞或中断）、启动时缺少 npm 包（19 仓）、UI 空闲冻结（24 仓）、localStorage 会话溢出（16 仓）以及 LiteLLM 供应链投毒（13 仓）。单仓问题以 workflow_runtime 为主，集中在 agentscope-ai/agentscope（无限循环/输出卡死）和 anthropics 各 SDK（超时、token 统计错误、权限降级）。
global_highlights: P0「静默失败」是覆盖面最广的共性问题，53 个仓库的任务在 planning/coding 阶段因超时或 agent 异常而被吞没，用户完全收不到错误提示
LiteLLM 供应链攻击（PyPI 投毒 v1.82.7/1.82.8）波及 13 个仓库，credentials 被盗；需快速评估是否受牵连
localStorage 存储 agent 会话在 16 个仓库中引发 QuotaExceededError，导致对话历史丢失且无跨设备同步
agentscope-ai/agentscope 存在两个 P0 级运行时缺陷：ReActAgent 无限循环和 `</tool_call>` 文本导致任务完全卡死，均为主流程阻断性 bug

top_pain_points.review_reason: Silent failures in the core planning/coding workflow directly block the primary user value proposition. Users cannot distinguish between a slow model and an actual failure, leading to wasted time waiting and confusion when tasks disappear into Human Review. The timeout is hardcoded with no user setting, compounding the problem. Count=2 with strong evidence from distinct failure modes (timeout and agent spec writing).

source_issues.title: Timeout Silent Error
source_issues.evidence: Tasks silently fail after 1+ minute wait on local Ollama; no error in frontend logs; task silently transfers to Human Review; hardcoded STREAM_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS with no user-facing timeout setting or error message

UI becomes unresponsive — user can send messages but agent never processes them. Backend logs show CancelledError and MCPTimeoutError. Session becomes a zombie. No error shown in UI. 30s hard timeout on MCP tool listing with no graceful fallback.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Sandbox failed to start within 120s

Corruption occurs intermittently during active conversations. Confirmed on v1.5.0.

top_pain_points.topic: Compromised LiteLLM dependency (credential stealer) affects OpenHands installations
top_pain_points.summary: LiteLLM versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8, published via PyPI supply chain attack, contain credential-stealing malware that exfiltrates API keys and environment variables. OpenHands depends on litellm and was at risk of pulling these compromised versions during installation or dependency resolution.
aliases: AIO sandbox file upload permission denied on file overwrite
API key not updating after quota replacement
AWS Bedrock tool_choice parameter validation error
Local provider not appearing after configuration
Max plan channels silently gated by feature flag
Ollama local provider not visible in UI
channels not available for Max users without notification
default database credentials in Docker Compose
experimental betas not suppressed on Bedrock
sandbox user cannot overwrite host-owned uploaded files
silent write failure review not posted
top_pain_points.review_reason: Although count=1, this is a P0 due to severe security impact: credential-stealing malware installed via a transitive dependency. The malware executes on every Python interpreter invocation and persists on the host machine, meaning API keys and credentials used by OpenHands may have been exfiltrated. Users are explicitly asking if they need to revoke their keys. This constitutes clear cost loss (potential credential theft) and critical security unavailability until remediated.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Compromised LiteLLM dependency

Users explicitly reporting as a bug affecting their installation, asking if they need to revoke keys.

signals.topic: App fails to launch due to missing bundled npm packages (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
signals.summary: Multiple npm packages (@libsql/client, @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider) are missing from the packaged app after installation or update, causing complete app launch failure across macOS and Windows.
signals.review_reason: App startup crash is a P0 blocker. Three distinct issues across two OS platforms (macOS, Windows) and multiple versions (2.8.0, 2.8.0-beta.4, 2.8.0-beta.6) all point to a systematic packaging/bundling failure in the electron build. Users cannot launch the app at all after install or update, making this the highest-impact pain point. The pattern across different packages indicates the root cause is in the asar packaging process, not individual dependency issues.

source_issues.title: 2.8.0 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND after installing or updating

source_issues.title: JavaScript Error during startup

signals.topic: Tasks fail silently during planning/coding phases with no error feedback to users
signals.summary: During planning and coding phases, errors (timeouts, agent failures) are caught internally but produce no user-visible error messages, causing tasks to silently transfer to Human Review or fail without explanation.
signals.review_reason: Silent failures in the core planning/coding workflow directly block the primary user value proposition. Users cannot distinguish between a slow model and an actual failure, leading to wasted time waiting and confusion when tasks disappear into Human Review. The timeout is hardcoded with no user setting, compounding the problem. Count=2 with strong evidence from distinct failure modes (timeout and agent spec writing).

source_issues.title: Timeout Silent Error
source_issues.evidence: Tasks silently fail after 1+ minute wait on local Ollama; no error in frontend logs; task silently transfers to Human Review; hardcoded STREAM_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_MS with no user-facing timeout setting or error message

signals.topic: Planning phase errors show blank/empty detail messages after Vercel AI SDK migration

aliases: error message not passed to task log
signals.review_reason: Regression introduced by the Vercel AI SDK migration. While the app continues to function, users cannot diagnose planning failures (rate limit, auth, tool errors) because error messages are swallowed. This is a degraded debugging experience that forces users to manually check CLI outputs. Count=1 limits it to P2, but the systematic nature (all task sources affected) and clear migration regression warrant inclusion.

source_issues.title: Planning phase errors have blank detail messages after Vercel AI SDK migration

source_issues.title: [BUG]: arize-phoenix 13.18.2 fails on import with FastAPI 0.115.14: AssertionError "Status code 204 must not have a response body"

signals.topic: Connection pool exhaustion: BulkInserter opens up to 7 DB sessions per loop iteration under sustained ingest load
signals.summary: BulkInserter creates up to 7 database sessions per 100ms iteration, exceeding the default SQLAlchemy pool size (5 + 10 overflow = 15 max). Under multi-replica self-hosted deployments, connection pool exhaustion causes query failures and data ingestion outages.
signals.review_reason: Connection pool exhaustion directly causes data ingestion failures under real production load in multi-replica deployments. While only 1 issue, the severity is confirmed 'priority:high' by maintainers, root cause is clearly identified, and it affects the core data ingestion pipeline of a self-hosted observability platform.

source_issues.title: BulkInserter opens up to 7 DB sessions per loop iteration, exhausting connection pool under load
source_issues.evidence: Self-hosted deployment with 2 Phoenix replicas producing ~30 connections under sustained ingest load. Connections pile up and queries begin failing. Root cause confirmed: 7 session opens per iteration not sharing a connection. Labeled priority:high.

signals.topic: UI freezes after tab idle, followed by crash/error on reload

aliases: unexpected error on reload after idle
signals.review_reason: UX degradation where the UI becomes completely unresponsive after idle, requiring manual refresh. After refresh, a crash screen is shown. This is a recurring, reproducible experience issue that interrupts the primary monitoring workflow, not a one-time edge case.

signals.topic: Agent chat messages stored in localStorage cause quota overflow and data loss, no cross-device support

signals.review_reason: While labeled enhancement, the design document explicitly describes a QuotaExceededError (data loss) scenario and lack of cross-device access, which are concrete user pain points. The issue represents a recurring data loss risk for power users with long agent conversations.

signals.topic: Sandbox environment fails to start or hangs, blocking core agent workflow
signals.summary: Users cannot start conversations because the sandbox (Docker runtime) either fails to initialize within 120s (500 error) or hangs during MCP tool initialization. MCP timeout leaves the UI in a zombie state where messages are sent but never processed. No error is shown in the UI.
signals.review_reason: This is a primary workflow blocker: the sandbox is the core execution environment — without it, the agent cannot run at all. Two separate users report complete workflow failure (sandbox timeout at 120s AND MCP timeout causing zombie sessions). The MCP timeout issue also hides the error from the UI, leaving users with a deceptive broken state. Both manifestations share the same root cause of environment initialization failure.

signals.topic: Corrupted metadata.json causes JSONDecodeError, making conversations inaccessible
signals.summary: In v0 conversations, the metadata.json file is written with duplicated trailing characters (e.g., ending with 'rsion":null,"public":null}' instead of valid JSON). This causes a JSONDecodeError when loading the conversation, returns 500 errors, and leaves the agent stuck. The corruption happens intermittently during in-progress conversations.
signals.review_reason: This causes workflow failure for users with v0 conversations: the corrupted metadata.json makes the conversation permanently inaccessible (500 errors on every access), and the agent gets stuck. This is a data integrity bug in the file write path that intermittently corrupts state. While count=1, the impact is severe (entire conversation becomes inaccessible with no apparent recovery path) and the evidence includes full stack traces and corrupted file content.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: V0 conversations have additional trailing characters in metadata.json
source_issues.evidence: metadata.json contains invalid JSON with duplicated trailing characters, e.g., 'rsion":null,"public":null}' appended to valid JSON. Triggers json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data at /api/conversations/{id} endpoint, returning 500 Internal Server Error. Agent gets stuck. Corruption occurs intermittently during active conversations. Confirmed on v1.5.0.

signals.topic: Litellm injects unsupported parameters causing model API errors for specific providers
signals.summary: When using certain models via OpenRouter (e.g., xiaomi/mimo-v2-pro), litellm adds extra parameters (reasoning_effort, native_tool_calling, extended_thinking_budget) that the provider API does not support, resulting in 400 errors. The same model works via direct API call, confirming the issue is in OpenHands/litellm's parameter handling.
signals.review_reason: This causes workflow failure for users who want to use specific models through OpenRouter. The model works via direct API but fails through OpenHands, demonstrating the issue is in the tool's parameter handling. Users are blocked from using their preferred model at all. This is critical feature unavailability for affected users, and likely affects any provider that does not support litellm's extra parameters.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: OpenRouter xiaomi/mimo-v2-pro returns 400 - incompatible request format via litellm
source_issues.evidence: Model works fine via direct OpenRouter API call but fails with 400 through OpenHands/litellm. Xiaomi API rejects with 'text is not present' error because litellm adds unsupported parameters (reasoning_effort, native_tool_calling, extended_thinking_budget). User has a paid OpenRouter account. First LLM call always fails, blocking the entire conversation.

signals.topic: Spurious rate limit (429) errors block users during normal usage
signals.summary: Users encounter unexpected HTTP 429 'Rate limit exceeded' errors during normal application usage. The errors appear to be triggered by frontend behavior (UI pre-rendering loops, multiple tabs) rather than actual abuse, and the error message itself is confusing (showing 'x per 1 second' instead of actual limits). Users are unexpectedly blocked from using the application.
signals.review_reason: This causes significant experience degradation and unexpected workflow blocking. Users performing normal operations (multiple tabs, rapid navigation, UI pre-rendering) are blocked by 429 errors that do not reflect actual abuse. The error message is also misleading. While the root cause (frontend loops vs. rate limiter misconfiguration) is not yet confirmed, the user impact is clear: legitimate users are blocked from using the product unexpectedly.

source_issues.title: Spurious rate limit errors: 'Rate limit exceeded: x per 1 second'
source_issues.evidence: Users experiencing unexpected 429 rate limit errors with confusing message 'Rate limit exceeded: x per 1 second'. Appears triggered by UI pre-rendering loops or multiple browser tabs, not actual abuse. Affects SaaS deployment. Users blocked unexpectedly from using the application during normal usage.

signals.topic: AutoGPT blocks fail with HTTP 401 Unauthorized when calling GitHub API (GithubReadIssueBlock, GithubListIssuesBlock)

signals.review_reason: Two distinct AutoGPT blocks (GithubReadIssueBlock, GithubListIssuesBlock) both fail with HTTP 401 Unauthorized when calling the GitHub API. The BlockUnknownError propagates up and halts any agent workflow relying on GitHub read operations. This is a clear auth permission issue that prevents key functionality from working, meeting the threshold for a user pain point.

signals.topic: Mid-stream SSE error events report wrong HTTP status_code (200 instead of actual error code)
signals.summary: When API returns HTTP 200 for streaming but then emits an SSE error event (e.g., overloaded_error), SDK creates error with status_code=200 instead of the mapped error code (e.g., 529). This breaks all retry/fallback logic that relies on status_code, causing cascading production failures.
aliases: SSE error event status code wrong
signals.review_reason: Real production failure: pydantic-ai's FallbackModel relies on status_code for retry decisions. The error body is correct but status_code=200 prevents fallback, causing cascading unhandled overloads. Clear code path and explicit reproduction provided.

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: In _streaming.py, when an SSE error event is received, _make_status_error is called with the original HTTP 200 response object, causing it to fall through to APIStatusError instead of OverloadedError. Production pydantic-ai fallback logic checks status_code >= 500 to retry — it never fires because the error is 200. Explicit reproduction case provided with accumulate_event replay.

signals.topic: web_search_20250209 dynamic filtering causes 50-60% pause_turn failure rate in batch workflows

signals.review_reason: Quantified 55-60% failure rate in production batch workflows with explicit cost/waste data. Users must resort to undocumented allowed_callers parameter as workaround. Failure is non-obvious — pause_turn returns no output but still bills tokens.

source_issues.title: `web_search_20250209` dynamic filtering causes excessive `pause_turn` at ~110 content blocks — batch processing impractical
source_issues.evidence: Production batch runs with 50+ requests: 55-60% hit pause_turn on first attempt, ~$0.15-0.25 wasted per failed attempt with no output. Setting allowed_callers: ['direct'] eliminates pause_turn entirely (100% success, 0% failure). Statistics provided across multiple runs showing 9+ hours for 17/35 items vs 38 minutes for 50/50. Also confirmed across ecosystem (Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK) with same root cause.

signals.topic: O(N²) performance bottleneck in MessageStream during structured output streaming
signals.summary: MessageStream re-parses the entire cumulative JSON buffer on every single streaming delta, leading to O(N²) complexity. For long structured output responses this causes high CPU usage and UI freezing, making the SDK unusable for real-time applications.
signals.review_reason: Significant performance degradation that makes streaming unusable for real-world structured output tasks. Clear root cause and fix identified but not yet applied.

source_issues.title: O(N²) performance bottleneck in [MessageStream](src/lib/MessageStream.ts#51-747) during structured output streaming
source_issues.evidence: Root cause explicitly identified: newContent.input eagerly recalculates partialParse(jsonBuf) on every delta. Causes high CPU usage and UI freezing for long structured outputs. Proposed fix: lazy getter for newContent.input.
