signals.topic: SDK writes invalid JSONL entries to session transcripts, breaking session resumption and causing cascading 400 API errors
signals.summary: The SDK writes assistant messages with empty text blocks and orphaned tool_result blocks to JSONL transcripts. When sessions are resumed or compacted, the Claude API rejects these with 'text content blocks must be non-empty' and 'unexpected tool_use_id' errors, wasting API calls and requiring consumers to implement custom transcript sanitization.
aliases: text content blocks must be non-empty error
signals.review_reason: P1: Causes 400 validation errors that waste API calls and interrupt ongoing agent sessions. The issue explicitly names multiple API error patterns and describes a cascading error loop. While count=1, the impact is high for long-running session use cases (the reporter's production scenario). Confidence 0.9 due to clear root cause analysis and error message evidence.

source_issues.title: SDK writes illegal entries to session JSONL transcripts (empty text blocks + orphaned tool_results)
source_issues.evidence: Long-running agent sessions that rely on compaction and session resumption hit 400 validation errors from the API. Two categories: (1) empty text blocks during streaming cause 'text content blocks must be non-empty', (2) compaction removes tool_use but keeps corresponding tool_result causing 'unexpected tool_use_id'. Forces consumers to implement fragile transcript repair logic before every API call.

signals.topic: ExitWorktree tool loses session state across separate query() calls, making worktree management unusable in multi-turn workflows
signals.summary: Worktrees created with EnterWorktree cannot be exited via ExitWorktree in subsequent query() calls, even when using the same session ID. The worktree session state is not persisted across query() invocations, making the entire worktree feature unreliable for multi-turn agent workflows.
signals.review_reason: P1: Worktree management is a core SDK feature that becomes unusable in the most common multi-turn usage pattern (separate query() calls with same session ID). The bug is confirmed with a minimal reproduction repo and a related internal commit referencing the same root cause. Confidence 0.95.

source_issues.title: ExitWorktree claims "no active EnterWorktree session" if worktree created in earlier query()
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction repo demonstrates the exact scenario: EnterWorktree succeeds, but a later query() with the same session ID calling ExitWorktree fails with 'No-op: there is no active EnterWorktree session to exit.' The issue also references a related commit 5a75d29 addressing 'EnterWorktree state lost across query() calls'.

signals.topic: dangerouslyDisableSandbox bypasses user approval and executes without permission after prior rejection
signals.summary: After a user explicitly rejects a tool call that would require disabling the sandbox, retrying the same operation bypasses the permission prompt and executes dangerouslyDisableSandbox without user consent. This is a security-relevant bug that circumvents user intent.
signals.review_reason: P1: Security-relevant permission bypass. After a user explicitly rejects a sandbox disable request, the SDK re-executes the same operation unsandboxed without consent. This circumvents user intent and could lead to unauthorized filesystem/system access. While count=1, the security severity is high. Confidence 0.85 due to brief bug report with attached logs.

source_issues.title: [BUG] dangerouslyDisableSandbox executed without user approval after prior rejection
source_issues.evidence: User added UV to project, was prompted for sandbox disable permission, rejected it, then asked the agent to retry. The agent executed the UV command outside the sandbox without permission. Logs attached showing the permission rejection followed by unauthorized execution.

signals.topic: Agent teams are completely unusable in headless/SDK mode due to session lifecycle
signals.summary: When CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set, teammates spawn as separate processes that return instantly; the SDK exits the session after ~11 turns before any teammate completes work, leaving multi-agent pipelines with zero output.
signals.review_reason: Root cause is confirmed and reproducible: SDK session exits immediately in headless mode after spawning teammates, causing complete failure of multi-agent CI/CD pipelines. This is a primary workflow blocker — the entire value of agent teams is negated in the action environment.

source_issues.title: Agent teams (TeamCreate/SendMessage/TaskCreate) are unusable in claude-code-action due to SDK session lifecycle
source_issues.evidence: Session terminates with end_turn after ~11 turns while teammates are still working. All workarounds (background spawn, watcher subagent, run_in_background:false) fail. Root cause: no foreground-blocking spawn mode in SDK/headless mode.

signals.topic: Workflow template generates insufficient permissions and action silently swallows write failures
signals.summary: The /install-github-app template uses pull-requests:read instead of pull-requests:write, and the action exits 0 on 403 errors when posting reviews, causing reviews to silently go nowhere with no user-facing indication of failure.
aliases: silent write failure review not posted
signals.review_reason: Two compounding bugs create a silent failure: the generated template has wrong permissions AND the action returns success on permission errors. The review runs to completion, reports green, but produces zero visible output — users have no indication anything went wrong. This is a complete workflow failure that defeats the entire purpose of the action.

source_issues.title: claude-code-review workflow template generates insufficient permissions; action silently swallows write failure
source_issues.evidence: Two compounding bugs: (1) template sets pull-requests:read but write is required for posting reviews, (2) action exits 0 on 403 from GitHub API. Result: job shows green, review never appears, no feedback loop.

signals.topic: use_sticky_comment silently ignored in agent mode — comment server starts without CLAUDE_COMMENT_ID
signals.summary: When use_sticky_comment:true is set but track_progress:false causes agent mode, the sticky comment feature silently breaks: no comment is created, the MCP server starts without CLAUDE_COMMENT_ID, and all update_claude_comment calls fail without surfacing an error.
aliases: sticky comment broken in agent mode
agent mode sticky comment silently fails
signals.review_reason: Sticky comment is a primary user-facing feature for PR reviews in agent mode. When enabled, it silently produces zero output — the comment never appears on the PR and all API calls fail silently. This blocks the core use case of tracking review progress on PRs, with no workaround for labeled-trigger workflows.

source_issues.title: use_sticky_comment has no effect in agent mode — MCP server starts without CLAUDE_COMMENT_ID
source_issues.evidence: Root cause: agent/index.ts hardcodes claudeCommentId to undefined. shouldIncludeCommentServer evaluates to true but MCP server starts without CLAUDE_COMMENT_ID. All update_claude_comment calls fail with 'CLAUDE_COMMENT_ID environment variable is required'. Workaround of track_progress:true breaks for labeled events.

signals.topic: Email notification spam: action sends one email per comment instead of one batched review email
signals.summary: After a recent update, the action started sending individual emails for each review comment instead of batching them into a single review email, causing email spam for PR authors and reviewers.
aliases: email per comment instead of batched review
signals.review_reason: Post-update regression that directly worsens user experience by generating email spam per comment. Users who rely on code review workflows now subject PR authors to a flood of emails, which is a significant degradation of core review functionality.

source_issues.title: Notifications Change
source_issues.evidence: Before update: one email per PR review with all comments. After update: one email per individual comment. User explicitly depends on batched behavior to avoid email spam.

signals.topic: Action built with bun crashes on self-hosted runners without AVX CPU support
signals.summary: Recent claude-code-action versions bundled with bun fail with 'Illegal instruction' on self-hosted runners lacking AVX CPU instructions, making the action completely unusable on a class of hardware that npm-based claude works fine on.
aliases: bun binary crashes on old hardware
signals.review_reason: Action hard-crashes with 'Illegal instruction' on self-hosted runners without AVX, making the action completely unusable on that hardware class. This is a complete startup failure, not a graceful degradation. Users on older VPS/infra are blocked entirely from using the action.

source_issues.title: Action fails on runners without AVX CPU support
source_issues.evidence: Action crashes with '748 Illegal instruction' when running bun run on self-hosted runners without AVX. The npm version of claude works fine on the same hardware. No fallback option currently exists.

signals.topic: False positive filtering step uses deprecated/removed model causing silent fallback to unfiltered results
signals.summary: The false positive filtering step calls claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 which has been removed from the Anthropic API, resulting in a 404 error and a silent fallback where all findings remain unfiltered with justification 'Claude filtering disabled'. The main security scan still works, but the false-positive reduction feature is fully broken for all users.
aliases: deprecated model causes filtering to fail
signals.review_reason: This is a user-facing bug: the false-positive filtering feature silently breaks for every user because a hardcoded model name has been removed from the API. Users receive unfiltered results with misleading justification text and receive no error signal, meaning they may not realize the filtering they expect is not running. While it does not block the main scan, it defeats the purpose of the secondary filtering step and degrades the value of the tool for security review use cases. Count=1 and single-repo scope limit this to P2, not P0.

source_issues.title: False positive filtering fails with 404: claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 model not found
source_issues.evidence: API returns 404 not_found_error for model claude-3-5-haiku-20241022; _filter_metadata shows confidence_score 10.0 and justification 'Claude filtering disabled'; all findings remain unfiltered instead of being filtered

signals.topic: Telegram plugin MCP channel notifications silently not delivered to conversation (cross-platform)
signals.summary: The official Telegram plugin (`telegram@claude-plugins-official`) successfully receives inbound messages and fires `mcp.notification({method:'notifications/claude/channel'})`, but Claude Code never surfaces them as `<channel>` blocks in the conversation. Affects both Windows (MINGW64/Git Bash) and Linux (Ubuntu), preventing the core use case of the Telegram channel integration.
aliases: notifications/claude/channel not processed from plugin MCP servers
signals.review_reason: Core plugin channel integration broken — plugin sends notifications successfully but Claude Code never processes them. Two independent reports on Windows and Linux confirm cross-platform scope. Users lose the primary use case of the Telegram integration with no workaround.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: inbound channel notifications not delivered to conversation (Linux)
source_issues.evidence: Plugin calls mcp.notification() at server.ts:925 without error, but notification never reaches the conversation. Bot polling works, gate authorization passes, outbound reply works. Root cause identified as how Claude Code handles notifications/claude/channel from plugin MCP servers on Linux.

source_issues.title: Telegram channel plugin: inbound notifications not delivered to conversation on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Same pattern on Windows/MINGW64/Bun: bot polls, gate passes, typing indicator visible in Telegram, mcp.notification() fires with no error caught, but <channel> block never appears in Claude Code conversation. Three hypotheses documented in issue.

signals.topic: Channels feature silently fails for Max users (feature flag gating) — no error or warning
signals.summary: Per documentation, Pro and Max users without an organization should be able to use channels via `--channels` flag. However, on Max plan accounts, channel notifications (`notifications/claude/channel`) are silently dropped with zero error, zero warning. Investigation reveals a GrowthBook feature flag (`tengu_harbor`) that gates channel eligibility before documented checks are evaluated. Users have no way to know the feature is unavailable.
aliases: Max plan channels silently gated by feature flag
channels not available for Max users without notification
signals.review_reason: Complete feature unavailability for an entire user tier (Max) with zero user-facing feedback. Users spend hours debugging before discovering a backend feature flag is gating the feature. This is the worst kind of silent failure — the documented behavior promises channels for Max users, the UI/CLI accepts channel configuration, MCP connection succeeds, but nothing works. Blocking severity with no workaround.

source_issues.title: Channels silently fail for Max users — no error, no warning
source_issues.evidence: MCP server connects successfully (status: connected), tools are listed and usable, notifications/claude/channel events send without error from MCP SDK perspective, but Claude Code never receives them. Root cause: GrowthBook feature flag tengu_harbor gates channel eligibility. Hours of debugging required before root cause found. Max users on claude.ai OAuth (not API key) are blocked.

signals.topic: Plugin cache drops execute permission on hook scripts in unknown/ directory causing Permission denied on every hook invocation
signals.summary: When a plugin is installed and its version cannot be resolved, Claude Code uses an `unknown/` subdirectory in the plugin cache. Files in this directory are written with 644 permissions instead of 755, causing 'Permission denied' errors on every hook invocation. Versioned cache directories correctly preserve execute bits. The unknown/ directory is regenerated on each session, making manual chmod a non-permanent workaround.
aliases: Plugin hook scripts lose execute bit in unknown cache directory
Permission denied on stop hook due to missing chmod on unknown/ path
signals.review_reason: Plugin hook execution fails on every Claude Code response with Permission denied, blocking the stop hook mechanism for affected plugins. This is a clear regression in plugin cache directory handling — versioned directories work correctly, only the unknown/ fallback is broken. Triggered deterministically for any plugin that lands in the unknown/ cache path.

source_issues.title: Plugin cache drops execute permission on hook scripts (unknown/ directory)
source_issues.evidence: Hook scripts in versioned cache directories have correct 755 permissions; scripts in unknown/ directory have 644. Error: '/bin/sh: /Users/<user>/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/ralph-loop/unknown/hooks/stop-hook.sh: Permission denied'. Affects ralph-loop plugin on macOS, stop hook fires on every Claude Code response.

signals.topic: Plugin SessionStart hooks fail — ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} environment variable not expanded for bash commands
signals.summary: Plugin SessionStart hooks that use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in bash commands fail on fresh session start because the variable is not expanded. The hook command receives the literal string '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks-handlers/session-start.sh' instead of the resolved path, resulting in 'No such file or directory'. Two official plugins are affected on macOS.
aliases: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT not expanded in plugin SessionStart hooks
Plugin hook command fails because env var not set for bash execution
signals.review_reason: Two official plugins are non-functional at session start due to env var expansion failure. The ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} variable is a documented feature used across multiple plugins, but only breaks for bash shell commands in SessionStart hooks. Clear regression in hook execution environment.

source_issues.title: Plugin SessionStart hooks fail — ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} not expanded for bash commands
source_issues.evidence: Both explanatory-output-style and learning-output-style plugins have SessionStart hooks using ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} which fail with 'bash: /hooks-handlers/session-start.sh: No such file or directory'. Other plugins (superpowers, context-mode) using the same variable work correctly. Workaround: disable affected plugins.

signals.topic: Plugin scope local entries ignore projectPath — wrong plugin version loaded based on array order
signals.summary: When a plugin is installed locally in multiple projects at different versions, Claude Code loads the first array entry in installed_plugins.json instead of matching by projectPath. Users working in a project with a newer plugin version get the older version loaded, leading to missing features or compatibility issues.
aliases: Wrong plugin version loaded when multiple local installs exist
signals.review_reason: Wrong plugin version is silently loaded, causing users to run outdated plugin features without any indication. This is a data handling bug in the plugin resolver that silently picks the wrong entry. Users may not realize they are using an old version until they encounter missing features or bugs that were fixed in a newer version.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Plugin scope: local entries ignore projectPath — wrong version loaded based on array order
source_issues.evidence: installed_plugins.json contains two local-scope entries for same plugin with different projectPaths and versions. When Claude Code opens project-b (which has version 1.0.2), it loads version 1.0.1 (first array entry) instead. Root cause: plugin resolver takes first array entry rather than filtering by projectPath. Workaround: manually remove stale entry from installed_plugins.json.

signals.topic: API usage promotion transparency and model quality verification lacking
signals.summary: Users cannot verify usage promotions (e.g., '2x off-peak promo') and have observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6, with no API endpoint or UI mechanism to audit actual quota or model variant being served. This creates an unresolvable trust problem for paying users.
signals.review_reason: This is a user pain point: a paying Max plan user ($200/month) is unable to verify the usage promotion they were promised (no quota counter, no model variant disclosure), AND reports measurable quality regression on Opus 4.6 for multi-step reasoning tasks. The inability to audit API quota and model variant constitutes a transparency/verification gap that directly impacts trust for enterprise/paying users. Evidence is concrete (specific model, plan tier, dates, corroborating social threads, outage dates). Count=1 only because this file captures a single repo's issues; the underlying platform behavior affects all API consumers.

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: User on $200/month Max plan reports: (1) no counter/endpoint/UI to verify actual remaining quota; (2) observed quality drops on Opus 4.6 for complex multi-step reasoning — model takes shortcuts, fabricates numbers, pattern-matches instead of computing; (3) base usage limits appear reduced ~50% before promo, making '2x' promotion indistinguishable from restored baseline; (4) corroborating Reddit threads on r/ClaudeAI, r/ClaudeCode, r/Anthropic (March 17-20, 2026); (5) coincides with March 17-18 elevated errors/outages on Opus 4.6. Users cannot distinguish genuine 2x increase from restored-reduced limits, and cannot audit which model variant is actually serving their requests.

signals.topic: iMessage plugin: self-chat echo filter fails causing duplicate message bubbles and email identity reply failures (two separate self-chat bugs)
signals.summary: Two distinct iMessage self-chat bugs: (1) The echoKey() signature strip regex never fires because whitespace normalization removes the newline before the regex runs, causing consumeEcho() to miss echoed messages and display Claude's replies as duplicate bubbles. (2) Self-chat using email identity fails with AppleScript error -1728 because AppleScript cannot resolve the any;-;email format for email-based chats.
signals.review_reason: Two separate self-chat failure modes: duplicate messages create confusing UX, and email identity self-chat is completely non-functional. Both affect a specific but legitimate use case (texting yourself to interact with Claude). Root cause identified in source code for both bugs.

source_issues.title: iMessage: echo filter fails in self-chat, causing duplicate messages
source_issues.evidence: Root cause in server.ts lines 418-420: echoKey collapses whitespace before the signature strip regex runs, so the regex never matches. consumeEcho() cannot match echoed messages, resulting in duplicate reply bubbles in self-chat.

source_issues.title: iMessage: reply fails on self-chat email identity (AppleScript error -1728)
source_issues.evidence: AppleScript error -1728 when replying to self-chat via email identity. chat.db stores email self-chat GUIDs as any;-;user@example.com which AppleScript cannot resolve. Phone number variant (any;-;+1XXXXXXXXXX) works. Root cause confirmed in AppleScript interaction layer.

signals.topic: Multiple plugins (learning-output-style, explanatory-output-style) missing required 'matcher' field in SessionStart hook definition — causes hook error on every session start and on /clear, /compact
signals.summary: The hooks.json files for learning-output-style and explanatory-output-style plugins register SessionStart hooks without the required 'matcher' field, causing 'SessionStart:startup hook error' and 'SessionStart:clear hook error' messages on every Claude Code session start and on every /clear or /compact command.
aliases: SessionStart hook error on session start and clear
missing matcher field causes hook failure
signals.review_reason: Hook errors appear on every session start for two plugins (learning-output-style, explanatory-output-style) and on every /clear or /compact command. While not blocking the main Claude Code flow, this is a recurring negative UX signal that makes users think something is broken on every interaction. Two independent issue reports confirm the pattern. Root cause is a simple missing JSON field in official plugins.

source_issues.title: SessionStart hook error: missing `matcher` field in learning-output-style and explanatory-output-style
source_issues.evidence: Both plugins' hooks.json files are missing the required 'matcher' field in the SessionStart hook definition. This causes two 'SessionStart:startup hook error' messages on every session start. Other plugins (superpowers, oh-my-claudecode) include the matcher field and work correctly.

source_issues.title: learning-output-style: SessionStart hook missing matcher field causes hook error on clear/compact
source_issues.evidence: learning-output-style plugin specifically causes 'SessionStart:clear hook error' on every /clear and /compact command. Root cause confirmed: missing 'matcher' field in hooks.json. Hook script itself works fine (exit code 0, valid JSON output) when invoked manually.

signals.topic: Telegram plugin silently drops inbound messages when no Claude Code session is active — no retry, no queue, no user notification
signals.summary: When a Telegram message arrives while no Claude session is active, the MCP notification call fails and the catch handler only logs to stderr. The message is permanently lost with no user-visible error, no retry mechanism, and no queue.
signals.review_reason: This is a primary workflow failure: inbound messages are permanently lost with zero user visibility. The failure is silent (stderr-only logging) with no recovery path. The user has no indication their message was dropped, and must manually retry outside the system. Confirmed by a detailed bug report with a working reference implementation.

source_issues.title: fix(telegram): messages silently lost when no Claude session is active
source_issues.evidence: The catch handler on mcp.notification() only writes to stderr. The user's message is permanently gone with no retry, no queue, no user-visible error. A reference implementation with SQLite WAL inbox and 20 unit tests exists but has not been merged.

signals.topic: iMessage plugin permission-relay sends sensitive tool descriptions and approval codes as iMessages to unrelated contacts
signals.summary: Due to a bug in how SELF is populated, the iMessage channel sends permission request prompts (containing tool names, full shell command previews, and approval codes) to dozens of unrelated contacts (SMS short codes, businesses, other people) rather than just the user's self-chat. Attacker-observable approval codes could enable unauthorized tool approvals.
signals.review_reason: Direct user-reported incident of data leakage to unintended third parties. Sensitive approval codes and full shell command descriptions were sent via SMS/iMessage to unrelated contacts. This is both a privacy breach and a security risk (external parties can see approval codes and tool descriptions). First-party user confirmation with a real-world incident.

source_issues.title: iMessage - Permission prompts sent to unrelated contacts via polluted SELF set
source_issues.evidence: User reported that permission prompts (containing tool names, shell command descriptions, and approval codes) were sent as iMessages/SMS to an unrelated contact who texted back asking about the weird message. The SELF set is polluted with dozens of non-self handles from SMS short codes, businesses, and other contacts. Approval codes are exposed to external parties who could reply to approve or deny actions.

signals.topic: ralph-loop stop hook runs in all Claude Code sessions due to session isolation guard failing open when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset
signals.summary: When CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset at loop start, the session isolation guard in stop-hook.sh skips its check entirely (empty STATE_SESSION fails the -n test), causing the ralph-loop prompt to be injected into every concurrent session in the same project directory. Sessions in dangerous-skip-permissions mode auto-execute the injected prompt.
signals.review_reason: Complete session isolation failure affecting all concurrent Claude Code sessions in a project. The ralph-loop prompt is injected into every session on exit. In dangerous-skip-permissions mode, the injected prompt auto-executes, meaning arbitrary AI behavior runs without user consent across all sessions. Root cause is precisely identified in source code.

source_issues.title: ralph-loop stop hook fires in all sessions when CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is unset
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified in two specific lines of code (setup-ralph-loop.sh:144 and stop-hook.sh:31-35). All concurrent sessions in the same project directory are affected. Sessions in dangerous-skip-permissions mode auto-execute the injected ralph-loop prompt. Issue is closed with fix confirmed.

signals.topic: Anthropic SDK API connection errors causing message creation to fail
signals.summary: Users experience intermittent 'Connection error.' when calling anthropic.messages.create(), causing the main API workflow to be blocked. Stack trace shows the error originates in the SDK's core.mjs makeRequest function.
signals.review_reason: 用户主流程被直接阻断。调用 anthropic.messages.create() 时抛出 'Connection error.'，导致整个 AI 图像分析功能不可用。提供了完整错误堆栈，错误源定位到 SDK core.mjs 的 makeRequest 方法。虽然只有一条记录，但影响明确：主流程失败、关键功能不可用，置信度高。

source_issues.title: API  Error Connection
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'Connection error.' thrown by anthropic.messages.create() in Next.js API route. Stack trace points to webpack-internal:///(rsc)/./node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk/core.mjs:338:19 at Anthropic.makeRequest. The error completely blocks the main message creation workflow, preventing any AI-powered features from functioning.

signals.topic: xlsx skill produces corrupt .xlsx files causing Format Exception on open
signals.summary: When using the xlsx skill to create new .xlsx files via the write tool, the generated file content causes a Format Exception when opened in Excel. The skill invokes the write tool to create the file but the raw content written is not valid xlsx binary format.
signals.review_reason: xlsx skill的核心功能（生成可打开的xlsx文件）完全失效，用户按文档流程操作却得到损坏的文件，无法正常使用该技能。这是明确的主流程失败/体验下降，P1评级合理。count=1且单仓但影响明确。

source_issues.title: how use skill xlsx to create new xlsx file?
source_issues.evidence: User reports openclaw cannot invoke xlsx skill to successfully create .xlsx files; write tool is called but produces files that throw Format Exception when opened in Excel.

signals.topic: skill-creator eval workspace files inadvertently read by Claude during project exploration, causing repeated unnecessary token consumption
signals.summary: skill-creator creates its eval workspace as a sibling directory to the skill (e.g. .claude/skills/grounded-plan-workspace/ alongside .claude/skills/grounded-plan/). When Claude explores the project for context, it glob/read these workspace files (benchmark JSONs, grading outputs, etc.) on every session — even when the grounded-plan skill is not active — burning tokens with no user benefit.
aliases: eval workspace accidentally read causing token burn
workspace files consumed by Claude during project exploration
signals.review_reason: 用户在每次项目探索会话中都被额外计费（runtime token消耗），且官方 workaround 会破坏 skill-creator 自身功能。提供了冷缓存基准测试证据，count=1但影响是持续性token浪费，P1合理。

source_issues.title: skill-creator: eval workspace read mid-session by Claude when exploring project, burning tokens
source_issues.evidence: Cold-cache measurement confirms cache_creation_input_tokens is 7,009 with and without workspace present; cost is incurred at runtime when Claude Globs .claude/skills/ during project exploration and reads workspace files. Workaround via ignorePatterns breaks skill-creator's own discovery workflow.

signals.topic: internal-comms skill cannot be installed via plugin marketplace or manual install command
signals.summary: Users add the anthropics/skills plugin marketplace and search for the 'internal-comms' skill but get told it does not exist. Manual install via /plugin install internal-comms@anthropic-agent-skills also fails with 'not found'. The skill is published in the repository but undiscoverable through both install paths.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能（skill安装）在主流程上完全失败，用户按官方文档操作却无法使用已发布的skill。这是明确的流程阻断/关键功能不可用，P1合理。count=1但影响明确，提供了截图证据。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Unable to install internal-comms skill
source_issues.evidence: User on Windows 11 Pro (CC 2.1.78) follows official steps to add plugin marketplace and search/install internal-comms skill — both search and manual install paths report skill not found, with screenshots confirming error messages.

signals.topic: Multiple providers fail to call tools/extensions, causing core Goose functionality to be unavailable depending on provider choice
signals.summary: Tool calling fails for multiple providers: NanoGPT (all tested models), Databricks (with Claude 4.6 adaptive thinking), and GitHub Copilot (gpt-5.4). Users who need tool execution are locked out of using these providers.
aliases: Databricks streaming parser fails on reasoning chunks
provider model incompatibility with tool calls
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：工具调用是Goose的核心功能，多个主流provider（NanoGPT、Databricks、GitHub Copilot）在不同场景下均无法正确调用工具，导致用户选择这些provider时核心功能完全不可用。NanoGPT案例中，同一模型在OpenRouter下正常工作，说明问题确实在Goose侧。

source_issues.title: NanoGPT provider appears unable to call tools/extensions
source_issues.evidence: Multiple NanoGPT models (Kimi 2.5, Deepseek 0324, Minimax M2.7) all fail to call tools with 'LLM did not call the required tool' errors. Same models work with OpenRouter, proving models are capable. Affects core Goose feature.

source_issues.title: bug: Databricks streaming parser fails on adaptive thinking response chunks
source_issues.evidence: ALL streaming responses fail for Claude Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 via Databricks. First chunk contains reasoning block that breaks OpenAI-compat parser, aborting the entire response.

source_issues.title: GitHub Copilot: `gpt-5.4` appears to be available but fails at runtime.
source_issues.evidence: gpt-5.4 model is discoverable and shown as available but fails at runtime with 'model not accessible via /chat/completions'. Misleading UX where a selectable model is actually unusable.

signals.topic: Desktop app shows misleading 'backend server failed to start' error on fresh install despite server actually running
signals.summary: On fresh install, the desktop app immediately shows an error dialog saying the backend server failed to start, but the log shows the server actually did bind to a port. This is a first-launch blocker that prevents any use of the app.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：桌面应用首次启动即报错，用户完全无法使用。即使用户提供了日志证据显示服务器实际已启动，UI仍显示失败。这在macOS和Linux上均可复现，且无任何诊断数据可捕获，是典型的高优先级阻断性问题。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Backend server fails to start on fresh install (desktop app) - resolves on relaunch
source_issues.evidence: Immediately on fresh install, error dialog 'The backend server failed to start' appears. Logs show server did bind to port. No diagnostics zip could be captured since app never launched. macOS and Linux confirmed.

signals.topic: Windows CLI: pasting text triggers automatic prompt execution and causes infinite loop, making CLI unusable
signals.summary: On Windows, pasting text into the CLI causes goose to auto-execute the pasted text as a prompt, creating an infinite loop that crashes the session. Users cannot paste any content without triggering this behavior.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：Windows CLI用户在粘贴文本时触发无限循环，导致会话崩溃且无法逃脱。这是严重的工作流中断，使CLI完全不可用，且无任何已知临时解决方案。

source_issues.title: Pasting into CLI auto executes and creates an infinite prompt loop
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11 CLI, pasting text causes goose to auto-execute pasted text as a prompt, creating infinite loop. Screenshot shows repeated auto-execution of the same prompt. No workaround available.

signals.topic: stdio extension `envs` config block not forwarded to subprocess, breaking any extension that reads config from environment variables
signals.summary: Environment variables defined in the `envs` block of a stdio extension config are silently ignored and never passed to the subprocess. This breaks the standard MCP configuration pattern where servers read API keys, URLs, and credentials from environment variables.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：stdio扩展的envs配置是MCP服务器的标准配置方式，当env变量被静默忽略时，任何依赖环境变量配置的扩展都无法工作。用户尝试了所有常见临时方案（shell环境变量、launchctl）均告失败，说明这是一个系统性bug而非边缘场景。

source_issues.title: Desktop App: `envs` config block not forwarded to stdio extension subprocesses.
source_issues.evidence: Subprocess receives no env vars and falls back to defaults (e.g. localhost:3000). Workarounds via shell profile or launchctl setenv both fail since goose is launched as an app. Makes it impossible to configure any stdio extension requiring env vars.

signals.topic: Provider config modal 'Update Provider' button silently fails when saving API key (LM Studio)
signals.summary: When configuring the LM Studio provider and entering an API key, clicking 'Update Provider' does nothing. The API key is not saved and no error message is shown to the user.
aliases: provider API key save fails silently
LM Studio API key not saved
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：用户在UI中配置provider API key时点击保存按钮无任何响应，且无错误提示。这意味着用户无法完成provider配置流程，核心功能对用户完全不可用。

source_issues.title: Provider config modal: 'Update Provider' button does nothing after entering API key
source_issues.evidence: Entering API key in LM Studio provider settings and clicking 'Update Provider' does nothing. No error shown, no save occurs. LM Studio API itself works fine.

signals.topic: fillForm agent tool drops value parameter, causing LLM to hallucinate fill values and break 2FA/login workflows
signals.summary: The fillForm tool receives a `value` parameter in its input schema but the execute function completely ignores it, passing only the `action` string to observe(). This causes the LLM to hallucinate placeholder values (e.g. 'test@example.com') instead of using the actual provided value, breaking login forms, search queries, 2FA/OTP flows, and any workflow that relies on custom tool results. The issue is flaky — it only manifests when the agent separates action description from value in the prompt, not when the value is embedded in the action string.
signals.review_reason: fillForm is a core agent tool that silently drops the `value` parameter, causing the LLM to hallucinate form input values. This breaks login forms, search queries, 2FA/OTP flows, and any workflow using custom tool results. The bug is reproducible with a clear root cause in the source code (fillform.ts execute function). Although count=1, the impact is high as it renders the fillForm tool unreliable for any value-sensitive use case, and the issue is confirmed closed, indicating it was a real bug.

source_issues.title: fillForm agent tool drops value parameter, causing LLM to hallucinate fill values
source_issues.evidence: The fillForm tool's inputSchema includes a `value` field that is never used in execute(). The observe() call only receives the `action` description, causing the LLM to hallucinate values. Custom tool results (e.g. TOTP codes) are also dropped, breaking 2FA flows entirely. Affects login forms, search, data entry, and any custom tool result workflow.

signals.topic: Stagehand hardcodes invalid 'minimal' reasoningEffort for gpt-5.4, causing AI_APICallError and blocking main usage flow
signals.summary: Stagehand hardcodes `reasoningEffort: 'minimal'` in aisdk.ts for all models, but gpt-5.4 only supports 'none', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh'. Using the 'minimal' value throws an AI_APICallError, blocking the primary act/observe/extract workflow for users on the gpt-5.4 model.
aliases: minimal reasoning effort not supported on gpt-5.4
signals.review_reason: Stagehand hardcodes 'minimal' as the reasoningEffort value which is not supported by gpt-5.4, causing a direct AI_APICallError that blocks the entire main usage flow (act/observe/extract). The issue is reproducible with a complete minimal repro and clearly identifies the root cause in aisdk.ts. The fix is trivial but the impact is high — users cannot use gpt-5.4 with Stagehand at all.

source_issues.title: Stagehand sets invalid OpenAI reasoningEffort: 'minimal' for gpt-5.4
source_issues.evidence: Full reproduction code provided. Error: AI_APICallError: Unsupported value: 'minimal' is not supported with the 'gpt-5.4' model. The hardcoded value in aisdk.ts line 183-194 causes the error. Fix identified as changing default from 'minimal' to 'low'.

signals.topic: 飞书（Lark）集成配置问题导致机器人无法正常工作
signals.summary: 飞书接入后部分功能异常：.env 文件中的 API key 无法读取（需直接写在 config.yaml 中），/help 等命令可用但正常提问时报错，机器人无法读取飞书文档，且只能使用 lead_agent 无法切换到其他自定义 agent。
aliases: Feishu/Lark integration configuration and functional failures
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用（count=3 独立 issue，同属飞书集成失效）：飞书是 DeerFlow 的核心集成渠道之一，三个不同方面的失败（配置读取、对话功能、文档读取、agent 切换）导致整个集成基本不可用，影响明确且直接。

source_issues.title: 有什么办法可以飞书连接agent，而不是lead_agent
source_issues.evidence: Feishu can only connect to lead_agent, cannot switch to custom agents. Self-built agents only accessible via local web.

source_issues.title: 按照文档接入飞书后无法使用
source_issues.evidence: Feishu integration follows docs but /help works but normal queries fail with error. .env API key not read, must hardcode in config.yaml.

source_issues.title: 飞书机器人不能读飞书文档？
source_issues.evidence: Feishu bot cannot read Feishu documents. Screenshot shows document access failure.

signals.topic: macOS 上 lsof 命令挂起导致 make dev 服务器启动流程无限阻塞
signals.summary: macOS 下 lsof -nP -iTCP 在查询 TCP 端口时会进入死循环（占用 99.3% CPU 持续 3 分钟以上），导致 wait-for-port.sh 脚本永远无法完成，make dev 卡在 'Starting LangGraph server...' 阶段，即便服务器本身已正常启动。
aliases: macOS lsof hang blocks dev startup
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断（count=2）：macOS 是 DeerFlow 重要开发平台，lsof 挂起使本地开发启动流程完全卡死，用户必须手动干预或修改脚本，属于开发环境初始化阻断性问题，两个独立 issue 确认根因一致。

source_issues.title: fix(scripts): lsof -nP -iTCP hangs indefinitely on macOS, blocking server startup
source_issues.evidence: make dev hangs at 'Starting LangGraph server...' indefinitely. CPU 99.3% for 3+ min. Root cause: macOS lsof enters infinite loop with -nP flags.

source_issues.title: fix(scripts): lsof -nP -iTCP hangs indefinitely on macOS, blocking server startup
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause: macOS lsof hangs with TCP socket queries using -nP flags. Causes startup detection to never complete.

signals.topic: AIO sandbox shell session 并发调用时返回 ErrorObservation 导致命令静默失败并引发级联错误
signals.summary: 当 LangGraph ToolNode 并行执行多个 bash 工具调用时，同一 shell session 无法处理并发请求，第二次请求在第一次进行中时到达，导致 session 状态损坏，返回错误对象字符串而非实际命令输出，后续该 session 上的所有命令也继续失败。
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：多智能体并行工具调用是 DeerFlow 核心能力，并发 session 损坏导致命令输出静默污染（错误对象字符串被当作真实输出处理），且级联影响后续所有命令，属于严重运行时破坏，用户完全无法依赖 shell 工具完成并行任务。

source_issues.title: 'ErrorObservation' from shell session server when concurrent exec_command calls share the same session
source_issues.evidence: Agent receives literal 'ErrorObservation' object string as command output, cascades to all subsequent commands on the same session. Caused by LangGraph ToolNode parallel tool execution.

signals.topic: AIO sandbox 模式下文件上传因权限不匹配导致 Permission denied 失败
signals.summary: AIO sandbox 环境中，文件先由 Gateway 以 root 用户写入宿主机线程存储目录，再由容器内 gem 用户尝试覆盖同一挂载路径时，因文件权限（root:root 644）导致 gem 用户无法重写已存在的文件，上传失败。
aliases: AIO sandbox file upload permission denied on file overwrite
sandbox user cannot overwrite host-owned uploaded files
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用（count=1 但有明确强证据）：文件上传是 AIO sandbox 模式的核心功能，上传失败直接阻断 PPT 生成、图片生成等依赖上传文件的关键技能使用。用户必须手动修改 umask 才能工作，根因明确为 Gateway 和 sandbox runtime 之间的文件所有权不匹配。

source_issues.title: AIO sandbox file upload can fail with Permission denied when uploaded host files are later rewritten by sandbox user
source_issues.evidence: Upload fails with '[Errno 13] Permission denied' when sandbox gem user tries to overwrite root-owned files at mounted path. Requires umask 000 workaround. Breaks image and file tool usage in AIO mode.

signals.topic: Next.js 16.1.7 Turbopack 下 ConsoleNotFoundError 导致聊天界面内部错误
signals.summary: 使用 Next.js 16.1.7 + Turbopack 模式运行 deer-flow 时，打开浏览器聊天立即触发 ConsoleNotFoundError 内部错误，导致前端无法正常使用，错误栈指向 langgraph-sdk 的 StreamManager.enqueue。
aliases: ConsoleNotFoundError in Next.js Turbopack chat UI
StreamManager.enqueue internal error on page load
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：前端 UI 完全不可用（打开聊天立即报错），影响所有使用 Turbopack 开发模式的用户，是明显的主流程阻断。根因指向 langgraph-sdk 与 Next.js 16.1.7 Turbopack 的兼容性问题。

source_issues.title: [runtime] Fix: ConsoleNotFoundError with Next.js 16.1.7 Turbopack and @langchain/langgraph-sdk
source_issues.evidence: Immediately upon opening chat in browser with Next.js 16.1.7 Turbopack: ConsoleNotFoundError in StreamManager.enqueue. Chat completely unusable.

signals.topic: Kanban feature entirely broken due to multiple independent failure modes (OAuth session rejection, xdg-open ENOENT crash, schema type mismatch)
signals.summary: Kanban Agent/CLI fails to function via three independent mechanisms: OCA OAuth re-authentication errors despite active sessions, Linux crashes due to missing xdg-open, and TypeError from incompatible AI SDK schema format. These collectively block the Kanban feature for all users.
aliases: Cline Kanban xdg-open crash on Linux
Kanban CLI TypeError schema not a function
signals.review_reason: Three independent failure modes all block the Kanban feature entirely. #9993 blocks prompt submission even with valid auth, #9991 crashes the CLI on Linux, #9990 prevents startup via TypeError. Combined they represent a complete feature breakdown.

source_issues.title: Kanban Agent fails with OCA OAuth re-authentication error despite active session
source_issues.evidence: Kanban Agent shows 'OAuth session for oca requires re-authentication' error on every prompt despite active session shown in Settings. Blocks Kanban feature entirely.

source_issues.title: Cline Kanban unable to open with xdg-open on linux.
source_issues.evidence: Kanban CLI crashes on Linux with 'spawn xdg-open ENOENT' error and unhandled promise rejection. No catch block to gracefully handle missing xdg-open.

source_issues.title: Cline Kanban CLI: TypeError: schema is not a function in @ai-sdk/provider-utils
source_issues.evidence: Kanban CLI crashes with TypeError during tool preparation. AI SDK asSchema() fails because Kanban passes incompatible schema format. Kanban CLI fails to start entirely.

signals.topic: Global hooks silently fail on WSL due to UI/runtime path mismatch
signals.summary: On WSL, the Hooks management UI writes global hooks to ~/Documents/Cline/Hooks/ but the hooks runtime reads from ~/Cline/Hooks/. Hooks silently never fire with no user-facing error, blocking the hooks automation feature.
aliases: Hooks silently never fire on WSL
signals.review_reason: Despite count=1, this is a critical silent failure: the user-facing UI confirms hooks exist and are enabled, but they never actually execute. No error message is shown. This is a main feature (global hooks automation) completely broken on WSL with no diagnostic feedback.

source_issues.title: Global hooks created in wrong directory on WSL
source_issues.evidence: UI writes hooks to ~/Documents/Cline/Hooks/ but runtime reads from ~/Cline/Hooks/. Hooks are created and visible in the UI but silently never execute. Verified with manual testing. Only workaround is manual symlink.

signals.topic: stdio MCP servers launched with cwd=/ instead of workspace root, breaking project-context-dependent servers
signals.summary: When launching stdio MCP servers, Cline uses cwd=/ instead of the current workspace root, causing MCP servers that depend on project context to fail silently or crash.
signals.review_reason: Root cause clearly evidenced via wrapper logging showing cwd=/ with no workspace env vars. MCP server that needs project context fails, breaking a core integration feature. Users relying on MCP servers that check project state are completely blocked.

source_issues.title: Cline MCP cwd Issue
source_issues.evidence: stdio MCP server launched with cwd=/ and no workspace environment variables. Verified via wrapper logging showing START_DIR=/ and missing VSCODE_CWD/VSCODE_PID. MCP server 'cocoindex-code' fails with 'Not in an initialized project directory'. Environment variables prove cwd=/.

signals.topic: File move operation silently overwrites existing file instead of checking if target is a directory, causing data loss
signals.summary: Cline executes move commands without verifying the target exists and is a directory. If target is an existing file, it is silently overwritten with source content, causing permanent data loss with no warning or confirmation.
aliases: move command overwrites files without checking
file overwrite data loss on move
signals.review_reason: Explicitly reproducible data loss bug: existing file silently overwritten with no warning. Source file deleted. This is a critical file operation safety failure that can cause permanent, unrecoverable data loss. Users cannot trust file operations performed by Cline.

source_issues.title: Cline should verify move target is directory before executing to prevent data loss from overwrites
source_issues.evidence: Reproduction: create target.txt (content A), create source.html (content B), Cline runs 'cmd /c move source.html target.txt'. Result: target.txt = B (source content), source.html gone. No confirmation, no check if target is a file. Permanent unrecoverable data loss.

signals.topic: Task resume crashes when api_req_failed state is present in UI history
signals.summary: Resuming a task with the -T flag crashes with unhandled promise rejection if the task history contains an 'api_req_failed' ask event, making it impossible to resume tasks that had transient API failures.
signals.review_reason: Explicitly reproducible crash: task resume feature completely broken when history contains api_req_failed state. Unhandled promise rejection crashes the CLI with no recovery. Users lose ability to resume interrupted tasks.

source_issues.title: Task resume crashes if api_req_failed present in UI history
source_issues.evidence: Reproduced: start task, then resume with -T flag after adding api_req_failed event to ui_messages.json. Crashes with unhandled promise rejection. No workaround described. Blocks task resume feature.

signals.topic: MCP server reconnection causes 'Already connected to a transport' error, blocking reload/disable/enable
signals.summary: When users try to reload or disable/enable an MCP server in Continue IDE, the reconnection fails with 'Already connected to a transport' error. The root cause is that the same Client instance is reused across reconnections and _transport is not cleared synchronously. All MCP transport types (SSE, STDIO, HTTP→SSE fallback) are affected. PR #11887 exists with a fix.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：MCP服务器重连失败导致reload/disable/enable功能完全不可用，直接影响用户使用MCP扩展的工作流，且影响所有传输类型(SSE/STDIO/自动回退)。

source_issues.title: MCP STDIO transport reconnection race condition causes inconsistent state
source_issues.evidence: Initial connection succeeds but any subsequent reconnection fails with 'Already connected to a transport. Call close() before connecting to a new transport'. Affects SSE, STDIO and auto-detect fallback paths. Confirmed root cause in MCPConnection.ts.

signals.topic: Tool execution completely broken for local (Ollama) models — tools silently decline instead of executing
signals.summary: After a recent update, tools (read_file, bash, etc.) stopped working for local Ollama models. The model repeatedly says it cannot access the file system and asks users to paste file contents. Previously working functionality (as of last week) is now completely broken in both Plan mode and Agent mode. Affects qwen3.5 9b and likely other local models.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：工具执行是Continue的核心价值所在。对于Ollama本地模型用户，工具完全失效意味着用户无法让AI执行代码操作，只能手动粘贴文件内容。严重影响使用价值。

source_issues.title: Tools no longer work
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'now the model complains every time that it doesn't have rights to read files' and 'I cannot directly access your local file system'. Previously working last week. Affects Plan and Agent modes. Model outputs unusable instructions like read_file(Main.java) instead of actually reading.

signals.topic: JetBrains: agent mode terminal interaction completely broken — users cannot type or select anything
signals.summary: In JetBrains IDEs, agent mode's terminal interface is non-functional. Users cannot input text or make selections in the terminal panel, making agent mode unusable. The screenshot shows an unresponsive terminal UI. Affects all JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, etc.).
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：JetBrains用户无法在agent模式终端中输入或选择任何内容，直接导致agent模式完全无法使用。这是IDE特定阻断性问题。

source_issues.title: When I use the agent mode via JetBrains' continue, I am unable to interact with it in the terminal.
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly states 'I am unable to interact with it in the terminal' and 'I can't input or select!'. Screenshot attached showing the broken UI. No workaround provided.

signals.topic: Azure OpenAI GPT models crash with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading call)' — all Azure users blocked
signals.summary: Every Azure OpenAI GPT model request fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading call)' inside the streaming pipeline. The same error occurs in both stable (1.2.18) and pre-release (1.3.34) versions, with streaming enabled or disabled. The same API endpoint works perfectly via curl, confirming the bug is inside Continue's Azure/OpenAI provider. Related to previously fixed issue #8700, indicating a regression.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：所有Azure OpenAI用户完全无法使用Continue，所有GPT模型请求均以TypeError崩溃。虽然只有一个issue，但影响面覆盖所有Azure用户群体，且有回归特征（关联issue #8700）。

source_issues.title: Azure - Openai GPT models: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'call')
source_issues.evidence: All Azure OpenAI GPT model requests fail with TypeError inside Continue's streaming pipeline. Azure endpoint + model work via curl, proving the bug is inside Continue. Affects both 1.2.18 and 1.3.34. Reporter also tested general OpenAI provider with same API — got ConnectionError. Likely regression from #8700.

signals.topic: Windows: prompt files in user HOME ~/.continue/prompts are detected but not parsed — content empty when selected
signals.summary: On Windows 11, custom prompt files placed in the user's HOME directory (C:/Users/<username>/.continue/prompts) are correctly detected and shown in the slash command candidates list, but selecting them results in empty content — the prompt name and description are not parsed and no content is inserted. The same file works correctly when placed in <project root>/.continue/prompts.
aliases: Windows HOME prompt path not working
custom prompts in home dir Windows broken
signals.review_reason: 体验下降：Windows用户无法使用用户级HOME目录下的自定义prompt文件，虽然有workaround（放在项目目录下），但用户体验不连贯，影响使用用户级prompt配置的用户群体。

source_issues.title: Prompt files in User HOME ~/.continue/prompts directory not being parsed in Windows
source_issues.evidence: Windows-specific bug: Continue shows prompt filenames in slash command candidates but selecting them yields empty content. Workaround is to use project-level prompts directory instead. Path expansion issue for ~ or HOME variable.

signals.topic: MCP tool resolution silently fails with UnboundLocalError when native MCP config returns no tools
signals.summary: MCPToolResolver._resolve_native() silently returns an empty tool list without logging a warning when the MCP server returns no tools or when tool_filter removes all tools. This causes an UnboundLocalError at line 412 when tools_list is referenced, crashing the agent execution with no indication to the user why the MCP server is not providing tools.
aliases: MCP server returns no tools causes crash
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed bug with a full stack trace showing an UnboundLocalError crash in agent execution. Users cannot understand why their MCP server (Stdio/HTTP/SSE) is not providing any tools because no warning is logged — the code simply crashes. This directly blocks the main agent execution flow.

source_issues.title: [BUG] MCPToolResolver does not log warning when native MCP config returns no tools
source_issues.evidence: Traceback shows UnboundLocalError at tool_resolver.py line 412: 'cannot access local variable tools_list where it is not associated with a value'. This is a hard crash of agent execution when MCP server returns zero tools, with no warning logged to help users debug.

signals.topic: crewai install fails on Windows due to lancedb platform incompatibility
signals.summary: Running crewai install on Windows results in a distribution error because lancedb==0.30.1 has no wheel for Windows (win_amd64), blocking the installation process for Windows users entirely.
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed installation failure with a clear error message. Windows users are completely blocked from installing crewAI, which is a critical workflow interruption for the entire Windows user base. The error comes from a hard dependency (lancedb) lacking Windows wheels, and the workaround requires manually editing dependency constraints.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Distribution lancedb==0.30.1 can't be installed because it doesn't have a source distribution or wheel for the current platform
source_issues.evidence: User on Windows 10 with Python 3.10 runs 'crewai install' and receives: 'Distribution lancedb==0.30.1 @ registry+https://pypi.org/simple can't be installed because it doesn't have a source distribution or wheel for the current platform'. Crewai install command completely fails on Windows.

signals.topic: Pro subscription users experience no performance improvement; gemini-3.1-pro-preview hangs or takes hours for simple responses
signals.summary: Paid Pro users report that response times are identical to free tier. The gemini-3.1-pro-preview model fails to return responses for hours, making the primary use case of the Pro tier unusable. Users paying for the service experience complete workflow blockage.
aliases: Pro subscription response time same as free
signals.review_reason: Two separate users on Pro subscriptions experiencing complete workflow blockage with the 3.1-pro-preview model. This is a core value proposition failure: paying users cannot use the primary product they paid for. Clear cost loss and service unavailability for the target premium tier.

source_issues.title: gemini-cli under a pro account
source_issues.evidence: User upgraded to Pro subscription but response time did not improve. gemini-3.1-pro-preview model takes hours for simple responses. User explicitly states 'I expected reasonable response time for flash models'.

source_issues.title: no es posible usar gemini cli siempre se queda pensando que le esta tomando mucho tiempo
source_issues.evidence: CLI hangs indefinitely with 'This is taking a bit longer, we're still on it' message on gemini-3.1-pro-preview. User cannot use the CLI at all.

signals.topic: CLI crashes on startup with TypeError: resolved.startsWith is not a function
signals.summary: When starting gemini with any --model flag, the CLI throws an unhandled TypeError in isCustomModel (models.js:216), completely blocking the CLI from starting. Full stack trace shows the error originates during Config._initialize and AgentRegistry.loadAgents, making the CLI completely unusable.
aliases: TypeError: resolved.startsWith is not a function
CLI fails to start with custom model flag
signals.review_reason: This is a complete startup crash: the unhandled TypeError in isCustomModel occurs during the critical initialization path (Config._initialize -> AgentRegistry.loadAgents). The CLI never becomes usable. This is a primary flow blocker with a clear stack trace.

source_issues.title: bug: "Reason: TypeError: resolved.startsWith is not a function"
source_issues.evidence: Unhandled Promise Rejection at isCustomModel prevents AgentRegistry from loading, causing CLI startup to abort entirely. User cannot start the CLI at all.

signals.topic: gemini-3.1-pro-preview hangs indefinitely with MCP OAuth on macOS/Homebrew (keytar.node missing)
signals.summary: On macOS with Homebrew installation, Keychain initialization fails with 'Cannot find module ../build/Release/keytar.node', forcing a FileKeychain fallback that triggers an infinite Help Agent research loop. The model never responds and the CLI hangs forever.
aliases: MCP OAuth hangs on macOS Homebrew
signals.review_reason: The CLI hangs indefinitely in a research loop, completely blocking the main workflow. The root cause (keytar.node missing in Homebrew bottle) is a packaging defect causing a cascading auth failure on a common installation path (macOS Homebrew Apple Silicon). Count=1 but extremely high severity and clear reproducibility.

source_issues.title: gemini-3.1-pro-preview hangs indefinitely on MCP OAuth authentication (macOS/Homebrew)

signals.topic: CLI hangs indefinitely trying to reach model servers (service availability failure)

signals.topic: BPB evaluation metric silently corrupted by tiktoken UTF-8 replacement character inflation
signals.summary: The core BPB evaluation metric — which drives the entire autoresearch experiment loop's win/lose decisions — is silently underestimated because tiktoken decodes invalid UTF-8 BPE tokens into the Unicode replacement character (U+FFFD, 3 bytes), inflating the byte-count denominator and producing artificially better scores.
aliases: BPB metric incorrect due to UTF-8 replacement chars
core evaluation metric byte count bug
signals.review_reason: This corrupts the primary decision-making signal for the entire research loop. Since BPB is the metric that determines which experiments are kept vs. discarded, silent metric corruption directly leads to wrong research conclusions. The bug is deterministic and affects all users using the default BPB evaluator, not a one-off edge case.

source_issues.title: Bug: BPB metric inflated by UTF-8 replacement characters in token byte count
source_issues.evidence: Code in prepare.py lines 188-193 uses tiktoken.decode() then re-encodes to UTF-8. For BPE tokens with raw bytes not valid standalone UTF-8 (e.g. continuation byte 0x80), tiktoken returns U+FFFD (3 bytes), inflating the BPB denominator. This silently corrupts the primary evaluation metric that drives the entire autoresearch loop: experiments may appear better than they are, and cross-run comparisons using different tokenizers are not comparable.

source_issues.evidence: Full reproduction code provided. Error log shows 'Error: String not found in file' on second summarization offload. signals.topic: CompiledSubAgent infinite loop: custom StateGraph ending with ToolMessage causes parent agent to re-invoke indefinitely

This is a main-flow blocking runtime issue for SDK users with custom subagents.

source_issues.title: CompiledSubAgent with custom StateGraph causes infinite loop when last message is ToolMessage

signals.topic: SqliteSaver.list()/alist() N+1 query pattern causing O(N) query degradation at scale

signals.review_reason: P0 criteria narrowly missed (count=1) but review_reason provides strong user impact evidence: N+1 pattern is a critical performance regression on a core API path that makes checkpoint listing operationally unusable at any real scale. 5x+ query amplification directly causes latency spikes and DB overload.

signals.review_reason: Demonstrated performance impact with benchmarks: 5x throughput reduction and 22x latency increase. A configured pool of 100 connections is rendered useless for async workloads. Clear bottleneck for concurrent deployments.

source_issues.title: AsyncPostgresSaver enforces instance-level threading.Lock() during asynchronous execution
source_issues.evidence: User provided benchmark: unlocked baseline 1295 req/s vs locked 199 req/s, median latency 73ms vs 2000ms. AsyncConnectionPool with max_size=100 is rendered ineffective by the lock.
