Marked P1 rather than P0 because while blocking, it is single-repository and count=2; no multi-repo or production-down evidence present.

source_issues.title: SDK bug on getTeamMembers call
source_issues.evidence: User calls vercel.teams.getTeamMembers({search: teamMemberEmail, limit: 1}) and gets error 'Parameter teamId is required'. The SDK does not support a teamId parameter but the API requires it.

source_issues.title: Bug: `getTeamMembers` requires `teamId` but does not accept one
source_issues.evidence: Error stack trace shows 'Parameter teamId is required' at url.js:10:23. Two different source files identified as root cause: src/funcs/teamsGetTeamMembers.ts and src/models/getteammembersop.ts. User confirmed no way to pass teamId through the SDK.

signals.topic: turbo watch is unstable: hangs, crashes and produces garbled TUI output
signals.summary: turbo watch hangs with mixed interruptible settings, crashes with Unix domain sockets, garbles TUI output on Windows, and loses packages under high concurrency — making watch mode unreliable as a core development workflow.
aliases: turbo watch unix socket I/O error
signals.review_reason: Five distinct but related issues all confirm that turbo watch is unreliable across platforms. The core dev loop (watching for file changes and rebuilding affected packages) is broken: tasks hang, crash, restart unexpectedly, or cause terminal corruption. This is a primary development workflow failure, not an edge case.

source_issues.title: turbo watch hangs when running multiple persistent tasks with mixed interruptible settings
source_issues.evidence: Watch event loop blocks completely when running mixed interruptible/non-interruptible persistent tasks. Only first interruptible task starts; second task never begins. Regression since v2.8.15.

source_issues.title: turbo watch triggers cascading task restarts in deep dependency graphs, garbling TUI
source_issues.evidence: Deep dependency graphs cause exponential cascade: build output is detected as a file change, restarting all dependents, which produce output, triggering more restarts. TUI becomes completely garbled on Windows (task names merged with status messages). turbo run dev does not have this problem — only turbo watch is affected.

source_issues.title: watch fails with many packages and tui
source_issues.evidence: Watch aborts with 'Could not connect to UI thread: channel closed' when running ~50 packages. Multiple invocations needed before builds complete. TUI thread fails to handle high-concurrency package graph.

source_issues.title: turbo watch behaves unexpectedly on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Tasks executed multiple times, some interrupted and restarted, some never run at all. Running the same command produces different results each time. ConPTY terminal state corruption visible in output.

source_issues.title: I/O error when creating unix domain socket in apps
source_issues.evidence: Second run of any app that creates a Unix domain socket triggers I/O error: 'Operation not supported on socket (os error 102)'. Turbo attempts to read the socket file, causing a crash. Reproducible on macOS and Linux. --no-daemon does not resolve the issue.

signals.topic: turbo prune --docker produces corrupted lockfiles across pnpm, npm and bun
signals.summary: turbo prune silently corrupts lockfiles for all three major package managers: pnpm drops new dedupePeers settings causing frozen-lockfile CI failures; npm omits deep transitive dependencies causing runtime errors after install; bun injects ~700 phantom npm packages causing structural mismatch. All three block Docker/CI workflows.
signals.review_reason: Prune corruption directly blocks Docker/CI multi-package-manager workflows — a primary use case. Four independent issues across pnpm, bun, npm all confirm the same root problem: turbo prune produces structurally invalid lockfiles that fail frozen-lockfile install in CI. This is a main-flow failure with concrete evidence of build-time breakage.

source_issues.title: turbo prune drops unknown pnpm lockfile settings (dedupePeers)
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified in LockfileSettings struct: unknown YAML keys silently dropped during deserialization, causing pnpm install --frozen-lockfile to fail with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH in Docker. DedupPeers (pnpm 10.33.0) is missing from settings after prune.

source_issues.title: turbo prune --docker injects phantom npm packages into bun.lock (v2.8.16 regression from #12228)
source_issues.evidence: v2.8.16 regression: pruned bun.lock contains ~700 phantom npm packages (@gar/promise-retry, @npmcli/*, @sigstore/*, cacache, libnpm*) not in the original lockfile. bun install --frozen-lockfile correctly rejects the structural mismatch. Regression from PR #12228.

source_issues.title: Issues with prune in latest release 2.8.13
source_issues.evidence: Pruned package-lock.json is smaller than original despite adding empty attributes. Deep transitive dependencies (@lexical/react installed at packages/pkg1/node_modules/@mdxeditor/editor/node_modules/@lexical/react) are missing from pruned lockfile. npm install then fails for code using these dependencies. Works correctly in 2.8.12.

source_issues.title: ls --affected accuracy issue when root package.json or turbo.json changes
source_issues.evidence: Although titled ls --affected, this also relates to turbo ls false positives on root file changes. Root cause: global file detection incorrectly flags root package.json as changed even when git shows it was not modified. Leads to all packages being marked affected.

signals.topic: turbo ls --affected reports false positives when root package.json or turbo.json changes
signals.summary: ls --affected marks all packages as changed on any root config modification even when git confirms root files were not modified, causing unnecessary CI rebuilds and wasted compute.
aliases: affected packages all changed on root file detection
signals.review_reason: turbo ls --affected is a core CI integration used to determine which packages to test and deploy. False positives cause unnecessary full-monorepo rebuilds, directly wasting CI compute and slowing down development velocity. Two independent reports confirm the same root cause in global file change detection.

source_issues.title: turbo ls --affected reports all packages changed due to false positive on root package.json when only workspace dependencies changed
source_issues.evidence: When workspace dependency sass is updated from 1.94.0 to 1.94.2 in a single workspace's package.json, turbo incorrectly flags root package.json as changed (git confirms it was NOT modified). Result: all 11 packages reported as affected instead of just 1. CI rebuilds entire monorepo unnecessarily.

source_issues.title: ls --affected accuracy issue when root package.json or turbo.json changes
source_issues.evidence: A whitespace-only change to root package.json causes turbo ls --affected to show ALL packages as affected. turbo build --dry=json correctly shows cache hits for all packages. Global file detection logic incorrectly marks root package.json as changed when only lockfile or sub-package configs changed.

signals.topic: eslint-plugin-turbo crashes at import when tasks/pipeline key is missing in package config
signals.summary: eslint-plugin-turbo crashes with TypeError at import time when turbo.json or package configs lack the tasks/pipeline key, completely breaking ESLint in affected monorepos.
aliases: eslint plugin turbo crash import tasks key missing
signals.review_reason: ESLint plugin is a key DX tool. A crash at import time blocks the entire linting workflow for any monorepo without tasks/pipeline keys — a configuration pattern that is valid and increasingly common in Turborepo 2.x configs. This is a critical-path failure with a clear stack trace and reproducible steps.

source_issues.title: eslint-plugin-turbo crashes at import time when tasks and/or pipeline keys are missing in a package configuration
source_issues.evidence: TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object at eslint-plugin-turbo/dist/index.js when turbo.json lacks tasks/pipeline key. Reproducible with a minimal repo. All ESLint runs fail, making the plugin completely unusable.

signals.topic: Turbo panics in enterprise CI/CD environments with Crowdstrike Falcon endpoint protection
signals.summary: Turbo crashes on startup in GKE/CI containers with Crowdstrike Falcon due to tokio pidfd_reaper regression, blocking all Turbo usage in affected enterprise environments.
signals.review_reason: Crowdstrike Falcon is deployed in a large proportion of enterprise CI/CD environments. The panic causes complete Turbo failure — no tasks can run at all. The root cause (tokio pidfd_reaper spurious wakeups under ptracer) is well-documented and affects multiple users in GKE and containerized environments.

source_issues.title: Panic in CICD containers with Crowdstrike Falcon enabled
source_issues.evidence: Panic at pidfd_reaper.rs:130 in tokio 1.42.0-1.47.0: pidfd receives spurious wakeups from Crowdstrike's ptrace-like monitoring, falsely signaling process exit. Oops! Turbo has crashed. Affects GKE pods with Falcon container injection. Solution: update tokio to 1.47.1.

signals.topic: vercel link --yes 自动拉取环境变量覆盖用户根目录 .env.local 文件
signals.summary: 自 v49.1.2 起，`vercel link --yes` 会自动将环境变量拉取到用户根目录的 .env.local 文件，导致用户原有的共享变量被覆盖，引发下游构建/部署问题。用户被迫使用 `< /dev/null` 等 hack 手段绕过。
aliases: vercel link auto-pull env vars corrupt user files
signals.review_reason: CLI 行为变更（v49.1.2）直接导致用户文件被覆盖，是典型的数据损坏类问题。虽然 count=1，但用户影响明确（有具体文件损坏场景），且在 monorepo 场景下严重影响自动化流程，标记为 P1。

source_issues.title: `vercel link --yes` should have option to skip pulling env vars to `.env.local`
source_issues.evidence: 自 v49.1.2 起，`vercel link --yes` 开始自动拉取环境变量到用户根目录 .env.local，覆盖了用户原有的共享变量文件，导致下游构建/部署失败。用户被迫使用 `vercel link --yes < /dev/null` hack 绕过。

signals.topic: vercel logs --expand 仅显示 logs[] 数组的第一个条目，后续日志被静默丢弃
signals.summary: `vercel logs --expand` 文档描述为显示完整日志详情，但实际只输出 logs[] 数组的第一个元素，其余 console.log/console.warn 调用全部被静默丢弃，导致调试信息不完整，误导开发者排查问题。
signals.review_reason: CLI 工具静默丢弃关键调试数据，是典型的'看似正常实则缺失'类问题。开发者依赖 logs 命令排查生产问题，数据不完整直接导致排查效率大幅下降，属于关键功能不可用（logs 功能实质受损）。count=1 但影响严重，P1 合理。

source_issues.title: CLI: `vercel logs --expand` only shows first log entry, discards remaining entries from logs[] array
source_issues.evidence: 代码仅读取 `row.logs?.[0]`，后续所有日志条目在类型转换层被丢弃。用户在无任何警告的情况下只能看到第一条日志，与仪表盘展示内容严重不一致，严重影响调试效率。

signals.topic: @vercel/hono preset 忽略 skipLibCheck 导致构建失败于传递依赖类型错误
signals.summary: @vercel/hono preset 使用逐文件的 TypeScript Language Service 进行类型检查，忽略 tsconfig.json 中的 skipLibCheck: true，导致 node_modules 中传递依赖的类型错误（如 @badrap/valita）引发构建失败。
aliases: @vercel/hono skipLibCheck ignored build failure transitive deps
Hono preset TypeScript build fails on node_modules types
signals.review_reason: 构建失败是明确的用户体验下降，但 count=1、仅影响特定 monorepo + Bun 组合场景，影响范围有限。workaround（设置 framework: null）存在，标记为 P2。

source_issues.title: @vercel/hono preset ignores skipLibCheck, fails on transitive dependency types
source_issues.evidence: 用户已在 tsconfig.json 设置 skipLibCheck: true，但 preset 内部的逐文件 TypeScript 分析仍检查 node_modules 中 .d.ts 文件（@badrap/valita），导致构建失败。本地 tsc --noEmit 正常通过，问题仅出现在 Vercel 构建环境。

signals.topic: Vercel 插件在 Windows 上错误报告「Vercel CLI 未安装」
signals.summary: Vercel 插件的 session-start-profiler 在 Windows 上将已正确安装并可用的 Vercel CLI 误报为未安装，原因是 resolveBinaryFromPath 在 Windows 上优先返回无扩展名的 npm 包装脚本而非 .CMD 文件。
aliases: Windows Vercel CLI not installed false positive
signals.review_reason: Windows 用户体验受损（误导性警告），但 Vercel CLI 本身功能正常，用户可绕过该提示使用 CLI，阻塞程度较低。count=1，标记为 P2。

source_issues.title: [Vercel Plugin] session-start-profiler falsely reports "Vercel CLI is not installed" on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11 用户安装 Vercel CLI v50.35.0 后，Claude Code 插件显示「Vercel CLI is not installed」，但终端中 `vercel --version` 正常工作。根本原因是 resolveBinaryFromPath 优先返回无扩展名的 shell 脚本，execFileSync 失败后未回退尝试 .CMD。

signals.topic: vercel domains add 对已被其他项目占用的 .vercel.app 子域名报错，但 vercel alias set 实际可认领
signals.summary: 删除旧项目后，新项目无法通过 `vercel domains add` 认领对应的 .vercel.app 子域名（报错 400），但 `vercel alias set` 成功证明该子域名在同一团队下可用。推测是已删除项目留下的孤立记录未正确清理。
aliases: vercel domains add vs alias set inconsistency orphaned subdomain
domains add fails for orphaned vercel.app subdomain
signals.review_reason: 域名操作失败是明确的用户体验下降，但 count=1，影响范围限于 Hobby plan 删除重建项目的场景，alias set 作为 workaround 虽不完美但可用。标记为 P2。

source_issues.title: vercel domains add fails for .vercel.app subdomain that vercel alias set can claim
source_issues.evidence: 用户在删除旧项目后创建同名新项目，domains add 报错子域名已被其他项目占用，但 alias set 成功证明子域名属于同一团队。--force 同样失败。alias 方式是静态的，不会随新部署自动更新，是不完整的 workaround。

signals.topic: Zed fails to start on Linux from desktop icon and with nushell shell environment
signals.summary: Zed either silently fails to start or crashes when launched from a desktop entry on Linux (XFCE, Kali with hybrid GPU), and fails to load shell environments when using nushell. Desktop icon launch is a fundamental workflow path for GUI users.
aliases: Zed fails to start from desktop icon on Linux
Zed fails to load shell environment for nushell
Zed fails to start on Kali Linux with hybrid GPU
signals.review_reason: Three separate but related Linux startup/environment failures. Desktop icon launch is the primary way non-technical users start GUI applications — its failure blocks the entire editor from starting. Shell environment loading failure prevents Zed from accessing the user's configured PATH and environment variables, which can break tool execution and LSP features.

source_issues.title: Zed fails to start from desktop icon on Linux
source_issues.evidence: On Linux, Zed does not start when launched from desktop icons but works when run from terminal. Regression from previous behavior.

source_issues.title: zed not start
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed on Kali Linux with hybrid Intel/NVIDIA GPU: Zed initiates from terminal but fails when clicking desktop or panel icons. Environment variable analysis shows no meaningful difference between terminal and icon launch paths.

source_issues.title: Failed to load shell environment for directory X: capturing shell environment with nu
source_issues.evidence: When nushell is set as default shell and a specific config.nu condition is met, Zed fails to load shell environment entirely, logging ERROR: login shell exited with exit status: 1. This blocks environment variable injection for the session.

signals.topic: LSP auto-suggestions / autocomplete not working (TypeScript and Go language servers)
signals.summary: LSP-powered code completion (auto-suggestions) fails silently: TypeScript LSP loads but no completions appear even with Ctrl+Space, and Go's gopls server is no longer found by Zed after an update, breaking Go autocomplete entirely. These are core coding productivity features.
aliases: Auto Suggestion LSP not working in zed
gopls not found by zed when it is already installed
signals.review_reason: Two LSP completion failures in different languages (TypeScript and Go) that directly break core autocomplete functionality. LSP is Zed's primary code intelligence layer — its failure makes the editor significantly less productive. The Go regression is explicitly labeled as a regression from a recent update.

source_issues.title: Auto Suggestion LSP not working in zed
source_issues.evidence: TypeScript/TSX LSP is active and loaded per status bar, but no auto-suggestions appear in code files and Ctrl+Space produces no results. User reports coding process is 'very difficult' and feels 'lost'.

source_issues.title: Regression(windows): gopls not found by zed when it is already installed
source_issues.evidence: Zed golang autocomplete was working before a recent update but suddenly stopped. gopls is installed and in PATH (C:\Users\jie\go\bin\gopls.exe) but Zed reports 'Could not install gopls because go was not found'.

signals.topic: Zed crashes immediately on startup (Windows Insider / STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN)
signals.summary: Zed v0.229 crashes silently on launch for Windows 11 Insider Canary builds, with no window rendered and no error dialog shown. Affects multiple Zed versions, blocking the entire editor from starting.
aliases: Zed crashes immediately on startup with exit code 0xc0000409
signals.review_reason: Critical startup crash blocking all usage on a specific Windows configuration. Despite count=1, the severity is extreme (application completely unusable, no window rendered) and is labeled P1 by maintainers. P0 is warranted due to total workflow blockage and cross-version reproducibility.

source_issues.title: Zed crashes immediately on startup with exit code 0xc0000409, STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRRUN on Windows 11 Insider Canary build 26200.8037
source_issues.evidence: Zed does not open any window; crashes instantly on startup. Event Viewer shows Exception code 0xc0000409. Reproduced across Zed versions 0.229.0, 0.228.0, 0.224.6 on Windows 11 Insider Canary build 26200.8037.

signals.topic: Agent response state corruption when requests are stopped mid-stream
signals.summary: When a user stops an in-progress agent response (especially mid tool action), subsequent requests get queued incorrectly: the UI shows no response for R2, then R3 shows R2's response, and R3's actual response appears only after Zed restart. Agent becomes unreliable after any interrupted request.
aliases: Agents behave in unexpected/delayed ways when a request in process/response is stopped
signals.review_reason: Agent state corruption after stopping a response causes response ordering chaos, making the agent unreliable and causing users to lose trust in the tool output. Labeled 'frequency:common' by maintainers, indicating this is a regular, not rare, occurrence during normal agent usage.

source_issues.title: Agents behave in unexpected/delayed ways when a request in process/response is stopped
source_issues.evidence: Labeled 'frequency:common' and 'state:reproducible' by maintainers. Multi-step reproducible: stop a tool-action response, type new requests, UI shows wrong/blank responses, correct responses appear after restart. Directly breaks the agent debugging loop.

signals.topic: Zed editor freezes when opening files with specific tree-sitter grammar (Haskell)
signals.summary: Opening any Haskell file after installing a specific tree-sitter grammar version causes Zed to freeze completely. The editor becomes unresponsive and the user cannot proceed with any work.
aliases: Zed freezes when pointing to my new grammar
signals.review_reason: Editor freeze is a critical workflow blockage. While triggered by a specific grammar version, the consequence (complete editor freeze when opening Haskell files) makes the entire language unusable in Zed. This is a core editing blocking bug.

source_issues.title: Zed freezes when pointing to my new grammar
source_issues.evidence: Steps to reproduce: clone haskell extension, update to a specific tree-sitter commit, install as dev extension, open any Haskell file. Zed freezes immediately. User is blocked from working with the entire Haskell language.

trend_delta: 3个新推进点（新）：GitHub平台级集成（gptme+Cline）、TDD规模化（gptme 200+测试）、多Provider路由抽象；MCP互操作层深化为相对3/23的新阶段；安全从"设计理念"到"系统性认证+速率限制工程实现"
historical_comparison: 今日相比3/23（安全+评估+MCP三足鼎立），出现三个质变节点：MCP从"生态扩张"升级为"互操作标准化"（mem0 HTTP transport、跨平台采样），eval从"评估闭环形成"升级为"TDD规模化"（单日200+用例），平台工具从"单点CLI"升级为"完整开发平台"（GitHub工作流+看板集成）。安全方向一脉相承（3/20设计→3/23落地→3/26系统性加固），但今天新增认证节流和速率限制，比此前单纯的PreToolUse钩子更系统。
top_new_trends: GitHub原生集成能力平台化（gptme issue/PR命令 + Cline Kanban看板）
TDD规模化落地（gptme单日200+测试用例，testcontainers真实环境成为主流）
多Provider路由抽象标准化（OpenAI any-llm + gptme entry points插件架构）
top_continuing_trends: MCP协议从工具调用协议向跨平台互操作层演进（Streamable HTTP transport + MCP采样工具）
安全从沙箱隔离升级为系统性认证+速率限制工程
